01d37ca72c35.name: Warrior Pride
01d37ca72c35.plain: At the end of your turn, score 3VP if 2 or more of your SPACE WOLVES units are each either within Engagement Range of any enemy units or finished a charge move this turn, and none of those units are within your deployment zone.

01f121115179.name: Spread the Sickness
01f121115179.plain:
If you pick this, your DEATH GUARD INFANTRY units can do this action. Spread the Sickness (Action): at the end of your Movement phase, 1 of your units can start it if it is within 3" of an objective marker that isn't contaminated. It can't start while any enemy units (not counting AIRCRAFT) are within 3" of that marker. It is completed at the end of your turn. Once it is completed, choose one:
• Roll a D6. On a 4+, that marker is now contaminated.
• The unit doing the action suffers D3 mortal wounds, and that marker is now contaminated.
When the battle ends, gain 3 victory points for each objective marker on the battlefield that one of your units has contaminated.

036fe5ae9ff0.name: Defend the Shrine
036fe5ae9ff0.plain:
If you pick this, then in the Resolve Pre-battle Abilities step of the mission you choose 1 objective marker outside your deployment zone to be the Sacred Shrine. If there is only 1 objective marker on the battlefield and it is in your deployment zone, that marker has to be the Sacred Shrine.
• At the end of your turn, you score 3VP if the Sacred Shrine is under your control and one of your ADEPTUS MINISTORUM units is within range of it.
• At the end of the battle, if the Sacred Shrine is controlled by your opponent, you lose 3VP from what you scored with this secondary objective (to no lower than 0).

03f394d0b253.name: Drop Zone Repleted
03f394d0b253.plain: Two objective markers are taken off the battlefield during this mission. At the start of battle round 3, the Defender picks 1 objective marker in no man's land at random: it becomes the Gamma objective marker. At the start of battle round 4, the Gamma marker is removed, and the Attacker picks 1 of the 2 remaining no man's land objective markers at random to be the Beta objective marker. At the start of battle round 5, the Beta marker is removed.

0504cead4256.name: Might of Terra
0504cead4256.plain: When a battle round ends, gain 4 victory points if 1 or more enemy units were destroyed in that round and none of your ADEPTUS CUSTODES or ANATHEMA PSYKANA units were destroyed in it.

058537f02af8.name: Might of Terra
058537f02af8.plain: At the end of the battle round, score 4VP if your ADEPTUS CUSTODES units destroyed 1 or more enemy units this battle round and none of your ADEPTUS CUSTODES units were destroyed this battle round.

075153837929.name: Battle-forged CP Bonus
075153837929.plain: At the start of every Command phase, yours or your opponent's, both players gain 1CP, not only the player whose turn it is. This CP is a Battle-forged CP bonus, so it doesn't count towards the usual limit of gaining at most 1CP per turn.

090400ae0e70.name: Hidden Archeovault
090400ae0e70.plain:
Before deployment, your opponent picks 1 objective marker on the battlefield that isn't in their own deployment zone.
• When a battle round ends, gain 2 victory points if you control it.
• When the battle ends, gain 5 victory points if you control it.

0aa73ff25df3.name: A Fitting Challenge
0aa73ff25df3.plain:
If you pick this, before the battle and after deployment zones have been chosen, find the 3 units in your opponent's army with the highest points values and note them down. If 2 or more units are tied, your opponent chooses between them. If your opponent's army has 3 or fewer units, note all of their units instead. A unit's points cost includes the points of all its weapons and wargear. If a unit splits into several smaller units during the battle, every one of them must be destroyed before the original unit counts as destroyed for this objective.
At the end of each battle round, gain victory points for each noted unit that was destroyed during the battle by one of your CHAOS KNIGHTS units (at most 6 victory points per battle round). How many depends on the battle round in which that unit was destroyed:
• Battle round 1: 6 victory points.
• Battle round 2: 5 victory points.
• Battle round 3: 4 victory points.
• Battle round 4: 3 victory points.
• Battle round 5: 2 victory points.
When the battle ends, take 1 away from the victory points you've gained with this objective for each noted unit that hasn't been destroyed (it can't go below 0). If a unit was destroyed, came back to the battlefield (by being resurrected or any other way) and was then destroyed again, it counts as destroyed in the battle round when it was last removed from the battlefield.
For example: if one noted unit was destroyed in battle round 1, another in battle round 4 and the third in battle round 5, you gain 11 victory points from this objective. If 2 noted units were destroyed in battle round 2 but the third had not been destroyed when the battle ended, you gain 5 victory points.

waive.BATTLE ROUNDVICTORY POINTS1625344352: garbled table header run from the source; the table (battle round 1: 6, 2: 5, 3: 4, 4: 3, 5: 2) is written out in full

0b32ae04aacb.name: Cripple Stronghold
0b32ae04aacb.plain: If you pick this, once both sides have deployed, your opponent picks 1 objective marker on the battlefield as their Stronghold objective marker. It must be one that is wholly within your opponent's deployment zone, if there are any. Your DEATHWATCH INFANTRY units can do this action. Cripple Stronghold (Action): at the end of your Movement phase, 1 of your DEATHWATCH INFANTRY units can start it if it is within range of the Stronghold objective marker while no enemy units (not counting AIRCRAFT) are within range of that marker. It is completed at the start of your next Command phase, as long as the unit is still within range of that marker. Gain 6 victory points each time one of your units completes this action.

0b3cf7118b43.name: Thin Their Ranks
0b3cf7118b43.plain: Keep a kill points tally if you pick this. Each time an enemy model is destroyed, add 1 to it, or 10 if that model had a Wounds characteristic of 10 or more. A model that is destroyed, brought back for any reason and destroyed again can add to the tally each time. At the end of the battle, divide your tally by 10, rounding down: that's how many victory points you score.

0b99db012432.name: A Clean Victory
0b99db012432.plain:
At the end of the battle round:
• Score 1VP if your T’AU EMPIRE units destroyed 1 or more enemy units this battle round.
• Score 3VP if your T’AU EMPIRE units destroyed 3 or more enemy units this battle round.
Which battle rounds you can score this in depends on the Tactical Philosophy you picked at the start of the battle. With Mont’ka, you can only score it at the end of battle rounds 1, 2 and 3. With Kauyon, you can only score it at the end of battle rounds 3, 4 and 5.

0bf98a424313.name: The Long War
0bf98a424313.plain:
At the end of your turn:
• You score 1VP for every enemy unit that your TRAITORIS ASTARTES units destroyed this turn and that was within range of an objective marker when this turn began.
• You score 2VP if any objective markers your opponent controlled when this turn began are now under your control, and one of your TRAITORIS ASTARTES units is within range of any of them.
This secondary objective gives you at most 4VP per turn.

0c4fc832e25f.name: Renew the Oaths
0c4fc832e25f.plain:
If you pick this, your IMPERIAL KNIGHTS units can try this action.
Renew the Oaths (Action): at the end of your Movement phase, one of your IMPERIAL KNIGHTS models within 6" of the battlefield's centre can start it. It is completed at the end of your turn, as long as the unit doing it is still within 6" of the battlefield's centre.
Each time one of your units completes it:
• Score 3 victory points if a non-TITANIC model completed it.
• Score 4 victory points if a TITANIC model completed it.
• Score 1 more victory point if a CHARACTER model completed it.
• Roll one D6: on a 4+, you gain 1 Honour point.

0d45bd7faf18.name: Uncharted Sequencing
0d45bd7faf18.plain: Before deployment, give each battle round its own objective marker and write this down on your army roster. The same marker can't be given to more than 1 battle round. When a battle round ends, gain 3 victory points if you control the marker given to that round.

0d92dc2662d4.name: Sacred Grounds
0d92dc2662d4.plain: If you pick this, your ADEPTA SORORITAS INFANTRY and CULT IMPERIALIS PRIEST units can do this action. Sacred Grounds (Action): at the end of your Movement phase, 1 of your ADEPTA SORORITAS INFANTRY or CULT IMPERIALIS PRIEST units can start it if it is in range of an objective marker your army hasn't consecrated yet. It can't start while any enemy units (not counting AIRCRAFT) are in range of that marker. It is completed at whichever comes first: the start of your next Command phase or the end of the battle, as long as the unit is still within range of that marker. Once it is completed, your army has consecrated that marker. For the rest of the battle, that marker gains the Inspiring (ADEPTUS MINISTORUM) terrain trait, treated as though it were a terrain feature, but it doesn't count as a terrain feature for anything else. Each time one of your units completes this action, score 1 victory point if the consecrated marker was wholly within your own deployment zone, or 4 victory points if it wasn't.

0e129120bcbd.name: Get Da Good Bitz
0e129120bcbd.plain:
If you picked this, then once both sides have deployed, the players take turns choosing objective markers outside every deployment zone to be Good Bitz objective markers, with your opponent choosing first, until 3 have been chosen. If only 1 such marker exists, just that one is a Good Bitz objective marker.
Your ORKS CORE units can try this action.
Get da Good Bitz (Action): 1 or more of your ORKS CORE units can start it at the end of your Movement phase. Each unit that starts it must be in range of a different Good Bitz objective marker from the others. No unit can start it while any enemy units (not counting AIRCRAFT) are in range of that same marker. It is completed at the end of your next Command phase, as long as the unit is still in range of that Good Bitz objective marker.
Each time one of your units completes this action, score 3 victory points.

0f19118fccfe.name: Objective Cleansed
0f19118fccfe.plain: An objective marker you control at the end of your Command phase, while at least one of your units in range of it has Objective Secured, stays yours even with none of your models in range, until your opponent controls it at the end of a later phase.

0f8633902836.name: Hold the Centre
0f8633902836.plain: Not scored in battle round 1. At the end of your Command phase, gain 5 victory points when both are true: you control more B-labelled objective markers than the opposing player, and more of your models than theirs are wholly within 12" of the battlefield's centre.

1258bb898da3.name: Leading From the Front
1258bb898da3.plain: At the start of every Command phase, a player whose WARLORD isn't on the battlefield (or embarked in a TRANSPORT model that is on the battlefield) rolls one D6: on a 1-3, that player doesn't get the Battle-forged CP bonus this phase.

132f1bb5d4b1.name: Champion’s Honour
132f1bb5d4b1.plain: WARLORD models have Objective Secured in this mission. A unit with a pre-battle rule letting it set up anywhere on the battlefield can't be set up in no man's land. Except for WARLORD models: a unit with a rule letting it move before the first turn can't finish that move in no man's land, and a unit with a rule letting it redeploy before the first turn can't be set up in no man's land.

134c99ac2da3.name: Abhor the Witch
134c99ac2da3.plain: You can't pick this if your army has any PSYKER units. At the end of the battle, score 5 victory points for each enemy PSYKER CHARACTER unit that has been destroyed, and 3 victory points for each other enemy PSYKER unit that has been destroyed.

136043ad4863.name: Inload Data-psalm
136043ad4863.plain: In battle rounds 2, 3 and 4, at the end of each Command phase, the player whose turn it is gets 4VP for every one of these they meet, to a maximum of 12VP: controlling 1 or more objective markers; controlling 2 or more; controlling more objective markers than the opponent. In battle round 5, the player who took the first turn scores this at the end of their Command phase as normal, but the player who took the second turn scores it at the end of their turn instead. Also, at the end of each of your turns (every battle round): if at least 1 of your units finished the Inload Data-psalm action this turn, you get 1VP per objective marker you control at that point, up to 3VP per player per turn.

1396b7338a39.name: Infiltrate and Subvert
1396b7338a39.plain:
If you pick this, your ALPHA LEGION INFANTRY units can attempt this action.
Subvert (Action): at the end of your Movement phase, 1 of your ALPHA LEGION INFANTRY units (not CHARACTER units) that is wholly within 6" of your opponent's deployment zone can start this action. It completes at the end of your turn, as long as that unit is still wholly within 6" of your opponent's deployment zone. When it is completed, if that unit is within range of an objective marker, roll a D6 to find out whether your army subverts that marker: a CULTISTS unit needs a 5+, and any other unit needs a 4+. Enemy units can never control an objective marker your army has subverted, and while they are within range of any such marker they can never perform actions.
Each time one of your units completes this action, you score 3VP, or 4VP instead if that unit was wholly within your opponent's deployment zone when it completed it.

13d1aa846e22.name: Despoilers of Reality
13d1aa846e22.plain:
If you pick this, your LEGIONES DAEMONICA INFANTRY units can attempt this action.
Dark Ritual (Action): 1 or more of your LEGIONES DAEMONICA INFANTRY units can start this action at the end of your Movement phase. Each of those units needs to be within range of its own objective marker (a different one for each unit) that you control, that is outside your deployment zone, and that your army hasn't corrupted yet. The action is completed when your next Command phase starts or when the battle ends, whichever comes first. Once completed, your army has corrupted that objective marker.
Each time one of your units completes this action, you score 4VP. Then roll a D6, adding 1 to the result for an ICON or INSTRUMENT unit: if you get 6+, your army gains 1 Warp Storm point.

1486ad1ccff2.name: Herd the Prey
1486ad1ccff2.plain: Not scored in the first battle round. When your turn ends, gain 2 victory points for each table quarter that has no enemy units (not counting AIRCRAFT units) wholly within it.

15746c210639.name: Synaptic Insight
15746c210639.plain:
If you pick this, keep a Synaptic Kill points tally, and set it back to 0 at the start of each battle round. Each time one of your SYNAPSE models destroys an enemy model (not counting Dedicated Transport models):
• If its Wounds characteristic was 3 to 5, add 1 to the tally.
• If its Wounds characteristic was 6 to 9, add 2 to the tally.
• If its Wounds characteristic was 10 or more, add 3 to the tally.
At the end of the battle round, score 3 victory points if your tally for that battle round is 4 or more. You can't score more than 12 victory points from this objective.

16ebafe6a0b9.name: Fear and Terror
16ebafe6a0b9.plain: When a battle round ends, gain 1 victory point per model that fled from any enemy unit in that round.

171a874c9c77.name: Despoil Dominions
171a874c9c77.plain:
If you pick this, your BLACK LEGION INFANTRY and BLACK LEGION BIKER units can attempt this action.
Despoil Dominions (Action): at the end of your Movement phase, 1 of your BLACK LEGION INFANTRY or BLACK LEGION BIKER units can start this action if it is within range of an objective marker that is under your control and that your army hasn't despoiled yet. A unit with the Troops Battlefield Role completes it at the end of your turn. Any other unit completes it when your next Command phase starts or when the battle ends, whichever comes first. In every case, the unit must still be within range of that same objective marker for the action to complete. Once completed, your army has despoiled that objective marker. From then until the battle ends, whenever an enemy unit within range of that despoiled marker starts to perform an action, roll a D6: on a 4+, that action fails immediately.
Each time one of your units completes this action, you score 1VP if the marker it despoiled was wholly within your deployment zone, or 4VP if not.

172181d44d5b.name: Scry Futures
172181d44d5b.plain: If you pick this, your ASURYANI PSYKER units can attempt this psychic action. Scry Futures (Psychic Action - Warp Charge 4): in your Psychic phase, 1 of your PSYKER units can attempt it if it is within range of an objective marker your army hasn't scryed yet. If it succeeds, pick 1 unscryed objective marker that PSYKER unit is within range of. Your army has now scryed that marker, and for the rest of the battle this psychic action's warp charge value goes up by 1 for your army. Gain 3 victory points each time one of your units completes this psychic action.

17c9f8bb6a48.name: Abhor the Witch
17c9f8bb6a48.plain: You can't pick this if your army has any PSYKER units. At the end of the battle, score 3VP for each enemy PSYKER CHARACTER unit that has been destroyed, and 2VP for each other enemy PSYKER unit that has been destroyed.

1812fc0a50b5.name: Titan Slayers
1812fc0a50b5.plain: At the end of the battle, score 10 victory points if 1 enemy TITANIC model has been destroyed, or 15 victory points if 2 or more have been.

19c7054cb783.name: Cull Order
19c7054cb783.plain: If you pick this, once both sides have deployed, you and your opponent take turns picking Battlefield Roles (HQ, Troops and so on) from among the units in your opponent's army, starting with your opponent, until 3 different Battlefield Roles are picked. If your opponent's army doesn't have units with at least 3 different Battlefield Roles, pick as many as you can. When the battle ends, gain 5 victory points for each picked Battlefield Role if every unit in your opponent's army with that role has been destroyed.

1be5e8495adb.name: Da Biggest and Da Best
1be5e8495adb.plain:
If you pick this, at the end of each battle round, score 3 victory points for each of these your ORKS WARLORD achieved, up to a maximum of 5 victory points:
• A melee attack by this WARLORD destroyed an enemy MONSTER or VEHICLE unit.
• A melee attack by this WARLORD destroyed an enemy CHARACTER.
• Attacks by this WARLORD destroyed 5 or more enemy models.

1c56995f0093.name: Duel of Honour
1c56995f0093.plain:
If you pick this, then before the battle, once armies are deployed, note on your army roster your opponent's WARLORD plus the 2 units in their army with the highest points value (not counting their WARLORD). If 2 or more units are tied, your opponent picks between them. If your opponent's army has 3 or fewer units, note all of their units instead. A unit's points cost counts the points of all the weapons and wargear it has.
At the end of the battle, you score victory points for each noted enemy unit that has been destroyed, if one of your IMPERIAL KNIGHTS units destroyed it during the battle. How many depends on how it was destroyed (Manner of Destruction):
• Honour to the King: a melee attack from your WARLORD destroyed it. 5 victory points.
• Personal Combat: a melee attack from any other IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model in your army destroyed it. 4 victory points.
• Cowardly Cur: it counted as destroyed because it wasn't on the battlefield when the battle ended. This doesn't apply if it is embarked in a TRANSPORT and that TRANSPORT is on the battlefield at that point. 4 victory points.
• Inglorious Demise: it was destroyed in any other way. 3 victory points.
At the end of each battle round in which you achieved Honour to the King or Personal Combat, you gain 1 Honour point.
When the battle ends, if the enemy WARLORD has been destroyed, you gain 1 more victory point, but you lose 1 victory point from this secondary objective (it can't go below 0) for each noted unit that hasn't been destroyed.
Example: your WARLORD destroyed the enemy WARLORD with a melee attack, a ranged attack by one of your models destroyed another noted unit, and the third noted unit was still on the battlefield when the battle ended. This secondary objective would give you 8 victory points.

1c8d36903c45.name: A Leap of Faith
1c8d36903c45.plain:
At the end of the battle round, you can discard 1 Miracle dice from your Miracle dice pool (it can't be a Cherub dice). If you do, you score VP based on the value of the dice you discarded:
• 1, 2 or 3: 1VP.
• 4 or 5: 2VP.
• 6: 3VP.
You can score at most 12VP per battle from this secondary objective.

waive.LEAP OF FAITH VALUE OF DISCARDED MIRACLE: a heading of the scoring table, not a keyword

1cc3c22ee44b.name: Defuse Explosives
1cc3c22ee44b.plain: Defuse Explosives (Action): at the end of your Movement phase, 1 of your units in range of a Primed Explosives objective marker in your own territory can start it, as long as no enemy unit other than AIRCRAFT is in range of that marker. It is completed at the end of your turn if the unit is still in range of the same marker. Then roll one D6, adding 3 if the unit has Objective Secured: on a 4+, remove that Primed Explosives marker.

1df7933738f8.name: Pile the Skulls
1df7933738f8.plain: When each battle round ends, and before you buy any Blessings of the Blood God, you may discard 1, 2 or 3 of your Blood Tithe points. Each point discarded this way scores you 2VP, up to 5VP per battle round.

1e092b9e6b16.name: Recon Sweep
1e092b9e6b16.plain: In battle rounds 2, 3 and 4, at the end of each Command phase, the player whose turn it is gets 4VP for every one of these they meet, to a maximum of 12VP: controlling 1 or more objective markers; controlling 2 or more; controlling more objective markers than the opponent. In battle round 5, the player who took the first turn scores this at the end of their Command phase as normal, but the player who took the second turn scores it at the end of their turn instead. Then, at the end of the battle, each player scores VP for how many objective markers their army has reconnoitred: 1 marker 3VP, 2 markers 6VP, 3 markers 10VP, 4 markers 15VP.

waive.OBJECTIVE MARKERS RECONNOITRED BY YOUR A: a table column heading, not a keyword

1e4485739082.name: Unified Advance
1e4485739082.plain: Not scored in battle round 1. At the end of each Command phase, the player whose turn it is gets 5 victory points for every one of these they meet, to a maximum of 15: controlling 1 or more objective markers; controlling at least 1 objective marker labelled A and at least 1 labelled C; controlling at least 1 each of the objective markers labelled A, B and C.

1e6433b41c35.name: Linebreaker
1e6433b41c35.plain: At the end of your turn, score 4 victory points if 2 or more of your units (not AIRCRAFT) are wholly within your opponent's deployment zone.

1f23784991d7.name: Take Them Alive!
1f23784991d7.plain:
If you pick this, when a battle round ends, gain victory points for each of these that is true:
• 3 victory points if a melee attack from one of your DRUKHARI units destroyed any CHARACTER or MONSTER units in that round.
• 1 victory point if a melee attack from one of your DRUKHARI units destroyed any unit (not counting CHARACTER, MONSTER or VEHICLE units) in that round.

1f8e410df584.name: Boots on the Ground
1f8e410df584.plain:
At the end of each of your turns, except your first:
• You score 1VP for each table quarter with at least 1 of your PLATOON INFANTRY units wholly within it (units within 3" of the battlefield's centre don't count).
• You score 1VP if at least 1 of your REGIMENTAL STANDARD units is either wholly within 6" of the battlefield's centre or wholly within your opponent's deployment zone.

244736089c25.name: Secure the Sanctuaries
244736089c25.plain: In battle rounds 2, 3 and 4, at the end of each Command phase, the player whose turn it is gets 4VP for every one of these they meet, to a maximum of 12VP: controlling 1 or more objective markers; controlling 2 or more; controlling more objective markers than the opponent. In battle round 5, the player who took the first turn scores this at the end of their Command phase as normal, but the player who took the second turn scores it at the end of their turn instead. Also, at the end of each of your turns (every battle round), you get 2VP if one of these is true, or 3VP if both are: you control the centre objective marker; you destroyed at least 1 enemy unit that started your turn within 6" of the battlefield's centre.

25bbac1de09a.name: The Ancestors Are Watching
25bbac1de09a.plain: At the end of each phase, score 2 victory points if, during that phase, one of your VOTANN units destroyed 1 or more enemy units that had 1 or more Judgement tokens. Score 1 more victory point for every one of those enemy units that had 3 or more Judgement tokens at the moment it was destroyed. At the end of the battle, take 1 victory point off what this secondary objective earned you (it can't go below 0) for each unit with 1 or more Judgement tokens that is on the battlefield, or embarked on a TRANSPORT that is on the battlefield.

2703493e6459.name: Fleeing Vectors
2703493e6459.plain: When a battle round ends, gain 3 victory points if any enemy unit that had 1 or more models destroyed by attacks with plague weapons in that round also failed a Morale test in that round.

27cb1f43f923.name: Raise the Banners High
27cb1f43f923.plain: If you pick this, your units can do this action. Raise Banners (Action): at the end of your Movement phase, 1 or more of your INFANTRY units can start it, each in range of a different objective marker that you control and that doesn't already have one of your banners on it. It is completed at the end of your turn. Then one of your banners is raised on that objective marker. The banner comes down if your opponent controls that marker at the start of any Command phase. For each objective marker on the battlefield with one of your banners on it, you gain 1VP whenever one of your Command phases ends, and 1VP more when the battle ends.

28c816b29b6b.name: Desperate Raiders
28c816b29b6b.plain: At the start of your Command phase, if you control at least 1 of the 2 objective markers in your opponent's deployment zone, you gain 1 extra CP on top of the Battle-forged CP bonus.

28f6a3566841.name: Surge of Faith
28f6a3566841.plain: In battle rounds 2, 3 and 4, at the end of each Command phase, the player whose turn it is gets 4VP for every one of these they meet, to a maximum of 12VP: controlling 1 or more objective markers; controlling 2 or more; controlling more objective markers than the opponent. In battle round 5, the player who took the first turn scores this at the end of their Command phase as normal, but the player who took the second turn scores it at the end of their turn instead. Also, in every battle round, each time one of your units completes the Surge of Faith action, you score VP depending on the objective marker it was done on. Player A: marker A scores nothing (N/A), B 2VP, C 3VP, D 4VP. Player B: marker A 4VP, B 3VP, C 2VP, D scores nothing (N/A).

296124e869d9.name: Data Intercept
296124e869d9.plain: In battle rounds 2, 3 and 4, at the end of each Command phase, the player whose turn it is gets 4VP for every one of these they meet, to a maximum of 12VP: controlling 2 or more objective markers; controlling 3 or more; controlling more objective markers than the opponent. In battle round 5, the player who took the first turn scores this at the end of their Command phase as normal, but the player who took the second turn scores it at the end of their turn instead. Also, in every battle round, each time one of your units completes the Data Intercept action, you score 1VP for each objective marker in no man's land you control at that moment, up to 3VP per action.

2b76fcf62ba7.name: Green Tide
2b76fcf62ba7.plain: At the start of the battle, split the battlefield into 4 equal quarters. At the end of the battle round, score 3 victory points if at least 2 of those quarters each have one of your ORKS units with 11 or more models wholly within it. Score 5 victory points instead if all 4 quarters each have such a unit wholly within them.

2d4f8cd2b29c.name: The Ancestors Are Watching
2d4f8cd2b29c.plain:
At the end of each phase, if your VOTANN units destroyed at least 1 enemy unit with 1 or more Judgement tokens that phase, score 2VP. Also score 1VP more for each of those destroyed enemy units that had 3 or more Judgement tokens at the moment it was destroyed.

When the battle ends, for each unit with 1 or more Judgement tokens that is on the battlefield (or embarked within a TRANSPORT model that is on the battlefield), take 1 off the VP this secondary objective has earned you (it can't go below 0).

2f62214119c8.name: Suffer Not the Alien
2f62214119c8.plain: When the battle ends, gain 1 victory point for each enemy TYRANIDS, AELDARI, ORK, NECRONS or T'AU EMPIRE unit that one of your DEATHWATCH units destroyed during the battle.

2fa0b62b2dee.name: Sow the Seed, Reap the Fear
2fa0b62b2dee.plain:
If you pick this, score 1VP every time an enemy unit does one of these:
• Fails a Morale test.
• Falls Back.
• Fails an action.
Also, each time a melee attack by one of your NIGHT LORDS models destroys an enemy unit, roll 2D6 before you take that unit's last model off the battlefield. If the total is equal to or higher than that enemy model's Leadership characteristic, score 1VP.

A model that is resurrected for any reason (destroyed and later returned to the battlefield) can give you victory points from this secondary objective more than once, if it keeps being resurrected and destroyed again and your 2D6 total equals or beats its Leadership characteristic every time.

2fd7ca2b4bcf.name: The Treasures of Aeons
2fd7ca2b4bcf.plain: If you picked this, then once both sides have deployed, your opponent chooses 3 objective markers on the battlefield. At the end of your turn, score victory points if you control 1 or more of those chosen markers: 2 victory points for 1 marker, 3 for 2 markers, or 5 for all 3.

waive.NUMBER OF SELECTED OBJECTIVE MARKERS YOU: a heading of the scoring table, not a keyword
waive.VICTORY POINTS SCORED: a heading of the scoring table, not a keyword

30a206b278be.name: Take Them Alive!
30a206b278be.plain:
At the end of the battle round:
• You score 3VP for every enemy CHARACTER or MONSTER unit that a melee attack from one of your DRUKHARI units destroyed this battle round.
• You score 1VP for every other enemy unit that a melee attack from one of your DRUKHARI units destroyed this battle round.
This secondary objective gives you at most 5VP per battle round.

30c8e940360c.name: Data Terminals
30c8e940360c.plain: An objective marker in no man's land that you control at the end of your Command phase, while at least one of your units in range of it has Objective Secured, stays yours even with none of your models in range, until your opponent controls it at the end of a later phase.

31daa736046d.name: Engage on All Fronts
31daa736046d.plain: At the end of your turn, score 2VP if you have qualifying units wholly within 3 different table quarters, all of them more than 6" from any other table quarter. Score 3VP instead if you have qualifying units wholly within all 4 table quarters, all of them more than 3" from any other table quarter. A qualifying unit has a Starting Strength of 3 or more models, or includes at least 1 VEHICLE or MONSTER model (AIRCRAFT models don't count).

32a79bb2af15.name: No Man’s Land
32a79bb2af15.plain: No unit can use a pre-battle rule that sets it up anywhere on the battlefield to set up in no man's land. A unit that moves before the first turn begins can't end that move in no man's land. A redeploy rule can't set a unit up in no man's land. Reinforcement units set up during the first battle round can't be set up in no man's land.

32dcef2964c6.name: Death from Above
32dcef2964c6.plain: When your turn ends, gain 2 victory points if any enemy units were destroyed by one of your BLOOD ANGELS units that arrived on the battlefield during the Reinforcements step of a Movement phase of yours (in any turn). Gain 3 victory points instead if any of those enemy units was a CHARACTER unit.

33d0e23d8e4b.name: Blood for the Blood God
33d0e23d8e4b.plain:
At the end of the battle round, if none of your WORLD EATERS units Fell Back this battle round, score VP for the enemy units that melee attacks by your WORLD EATERS models destroyed this battle round:
• 2VP for each enemy MONSTER, CHARACTER or VEHICLE unit.
• 1VP for each other enemy unit.
You can score at most 4VP each battle round from this.

343434543fef.name: Raid Supply Lines
343434543fef.plain: In battle rounds 2, 3 and 4, at the end of each Command phase, the player whose turn it is gets 4VP for every one of these they meet, to a maximum of 12VP: controlling 2 or more objective markers; controlling 3 or more; controlling more objective markers than the opponent. In battle round 5, the player who took the first turn scores this at the end of their Command phase as normal, but the player who took the second turn scores it at the end of their turn instead. Also, at the end of each of your turns (every battle round), you get 3VP if you control at least 1 of the objective markers in your opponent's deployment zone.

36c2063eda8c.name: Warrior Pride
36c2063eda8c.plain: At the end of your turn, score 3 victory points if 2 or more of your SPACE WOLVES units are within Engagement Range of any enemy units or finished a charge move this turn.

37bb5b9a8fed.name: Weave Veil
37bb5b9a8fed.plain: If you pick this, your SHADOWSEER models can attempt this psychic action. Weave Veil (Psychic Action - Warp Charge 4): in your Psychic phase, 1 of your SHADOWSEER models can attempt it if it is within 12" of an enemy unit your army hasn't veiled yet. If it succeeds, pick 1 enemy unit your army hasn't veiled yet that is within 12" of that SHADOWSEER model. Your army has now veiled that unit, and for the rest of the battle this psychic action's warp charge value goes up by 1 for your army. Gain 3 victory points each time one of your units completes this psychic action.

3887b445a4ff.name: Relentless Assault
3887b445a4ff.plain: When your turn ends, gain 4 victory points if you have more BLOOD ANGELS units in the enemy deployment zone than your opponent has units in your deployment zone.

39e460cbaa94.name: For the Dark Gods
39e460cbaa94.plain:
If you pick this, keep a tally called For the Dark Gods. It goes up by 1 each time one of your units dedicates a table quarter to a Chaos God by doing this action.
For the Dark Gods (Action): at the end of your Movement phase, one of your TRAITORIS ASTARTES INFANTRY or TRAITORIS ASTARTES BIKER units can start it if it is wholly within a table quarter your army hasn't yet dedicated to a Chaos God, and is within 3" of that quarter's centre. If the unit had the Objective Secured ability when it started, it finishes at the end of your turn; if not, it finishes at the start of your next Command phase. Either way, it only completes if the unit is still within 3" of that same table quarter's centre. When it completes, choose Khorne, Tzeentch, Nurgle or Slaanesh and dedicate that table quarter to that god. A KHORNE, TZEENTCH, NURGLE or SLAANESH unit that completes it can only choose its own patron deity (for example, a KHORNE unit can only choose Khorne). Your army can't dedicate the same table quarter to more than 1 Chaos God.
While one of your TRAITORIS ASTARTES units is wholly within a table quarter your army has dedicated to a Chaos God, add 2 to the Leadership characteristic of its models, unless that god isn't their patron deity (for example, if a quarter is dedicated to KHORNE, your TZEENTCH, NURGLE and SLAANESH units don't get this bonus).
At the end of the battle, score victory points based on your tally: a tally of 1 gives 2 victory points, 2 gives 5, 3 gives 9 and 4 gives 14.

3a8afdafbb80.name: Decisive Action
3a8afdafbb80.plain:
If you chose the Mont'ka Tactical Philosophy at the start of the battle: at the end of your turn in battle rounds 1, 2 and 3, score 4 victory points if you control at least half of all the objective markers on the battlefield.
If you chose the Kauyon Tactical Philosophy at the start of the battle: the same, but at the end of your turn in battle rounds 3, 4 and 5.

3b2fcb77efb6.name: Psychic Ritual
3b2fcb77efb6.plain: Psychic Ritual (Psychic Action - Warp Charge 3): in your Psychic phase, 1 PSYKER CHARACTER unit from your army within 6" of the battlefield's centre can attempt it. When the battle ends, gain 15 victory points if any of your units completed it 3 times during the battle.

3b84f60a5e9a.name: Blade of Sanguinius
3b84f60a5e9a.plain:
At the start of your first Command phase, you pick 1 of your BLOOD ANGELS CHARACTER models to issue a challenge, and your opponent picks 1 of their CHARACTER models to accept it. A player who has no CHARACTER model picks their WARLORD instead.
When the battle ends, gain 5 victory points for each of these that has happened:
• The model that accepted the challenge was destroyed.
• It was destroyed by a melee attack.
• It was destroyed by a melee attack from the model that issued the challenge.

3bd317fd766d.name: Stand Vigil
3bd317fd766d.plain: Only count objective markers that aren't within either player's deployment zone. When a battle round ends, gain 3 victory points if you control more of those markers than your opponent does.

3cae1d53a60c.name: Lay Claim
3cae1d53a60c.plain: If you picked this, then during the Resolve Pre-battle Abilities step your opponent has to place 3 objective markers on the battlefield's ground level, anywhere that isn't within 6" of their own deployment zone or of any battlefield edge. The markers can't be within 9" of each other, and can't go on terrain features that have the Unstable Position terrain trait. A marker that can't be set up isn't set up. Each one is a Precious Resources marker. It only counts as an objective marker for this secondary objective, not for any other rules. At the end of the battle, score 5 victory points per Precious Resources objective marker of yours that you control.

3d41617a66d2.name: Secure the Rear
3d41617a66d2.plain: At the start of every Command phase: if Player A doesn't control objective marker A, Player A rolls one D6, and on a 1-3 they don't get the Battle-forged CP bonus this phase. Player B does the same if they don't control objective marker B.

3dc355a907de.name: Mental Interrogation
3dc355a907de.plain: Score 3 victory points each time you complete this psychic action. Mental Interrogation (Psychic Action - Warp Charge 4): in your Psychic phase, 1 PSYKER CHARACTER from your army within 18" of any enemy CHARACTER models can attempt it.

3dc7d8d98d7b.name: Assassination
3dc7d8d98d7b.plain: This has a progressive part and an end-game part. Progressive: at the end of each battle round, if an attack by one of your Troops, ARMIGER-CLASS or WAR DOG-CLASS units destroyed any enemy CHARACTER unit during that battle round, you gain 1 CP. End game: when the battle ends, gain 3VP for every enemy CHARACTER unit that has been destroyed, plus 1 more VP if the enemy WARLORD has been destroyed.

3ec383b00c47.name: Teleport Assault
3ec383b00c47.plain: At the end of the battle round, score 3 victory points if 1 or more enemy units were destroyed by one of your GREY KNIGHTS models that was set up on the battlefield with the Teleport Strike ability, with the Teleportation Shunt Stratagem or with the Gate of Infinity psychic power, during that battle round.

3f16986254f9.name: Engage on All Fronts
3f16986254f9.plain: At the end of your turn, gain 2 victory points if you have 1 or more of your units wholly within 3 different table quarters, all of them more than 6" from the battlefield's centre. If you have units wholly within all 4 table quarters, again all more than 6" from the centre, gain 3 victory points instead.

42dc278069f7.name: Survey
42dc278069f7.plain: Not scored in battle round 1. At the end of your Command phase, score 5 victory points if you control both objective markers that aren't in either player's deployment zone.

43b960ce5d28.name: Burn Empires
43b960ce5d28.plain:
If you pick this, your THOUSAND SONS INFANTRY units can try this action.
Burn Empires (Action): at the end of your Movement phase, 1 or more of your THOUSAND SONS INFANTRY units can start it. Each unit that starts it must be in range of an objective marker outside your deployment zone that hasn't been burned, with each unit at a different marker. A unit can't start it while any enemy units (not counting AIRCRAFT) are in range of that same marker. It is completed at the start of your next Command phase, or when the battle ends if that comes first. When it is completed, that objective marker has been burned.
Score 4 victory points each time one of your units completes this action.

waive.40000: part of the book title "Warhammer 40,000 Core Book"

460628c0cee4.name: Strategic Scan
460628c0cee4.plain: In battle rounds 2, 3 and 4, at the end of each Command phase, the player whose turn it is gets 4VP for every one of these they meet, to a maximum of 12VP: controlling 1 or more objective markers; controlling 2 or more; controlling more objective markers than the opponent. In battle round 5, the player who took the first turn scores this at the end of their Command phase as normal, but the player who took the second turn scores it at the end of their turn instead. Then, when the battle ends, each player gets 3VP per objective marker on the battlefield that their army has scanned.

47244bd109b5.name: Stubborn Defiance
47244bd109b5.plain:
In your first Command phase, choose 1 objective marker outside your deployment zone. Then, at the end of every one of your Command phases, check whether you control it and one of your DARK ANGELS units with the Objective Secured ability is within range of it. If so, you score VP based on how many of your Command phases in a row you have controlled that marker with that unit within range of it:
• 1 Command phase: 1VP.
• 2 in a row: 2VP.
• 3 in a row: 3VP.
• 4 in a row: 4VP.
• 5 in a row: 5VP.
For example: at the end of your third Command phase, you score 3VP if you have controlled the chosen marker for 3 of your Command phases in a row, and that same DARK ANGELS unit, which has the Objective Secured ability, was within range of it at the end of each one.

waive.STUBBORN DEFIANCE CONSECUTIVE NUMBER OF: a heading of the scoring table, not a keyword
waive.VICTORY POINTS: a heading of the scoring table, not a keyword

494d9cede600.name: Aerospace Targeting Relays
494d9cede600.plain:
If you pick this, place an Aerospace Designation marker halfway along each battlefield edge. Your T’AU EMPIRE INFANTRY units can do this action. Install Targeting Relay (Action): at the end of your Movement phase, 1 or more of your T’AU EMPIRE INFANTRY units can start it. Each unit that starts it must be within 6" of a different Aerospace Designation marker where your army hasn't installed a targeting relay yet. When a FIRE WARRIOR TEAM unit is doing it, it is completed at the end of your turn. Any other unit completes it when your next Command phase starts, or when the battle ends if that is sooner. Once it is completed, your army has installed a targeting relay at that Aerospace Designation marker.

At the end of the battle, score VP for the number of targeting relays your army installed:
• 1 relay: 2VP.
• 2 relays: 6VP.
• 3 relays: 9VP.
• 4 relays: 15VP.

waive.AEROSPACE TARGETING RELAYS NUMBER OF TAR: a heading of the scoring table, not a keyword

49845a5df465.name: Path of Destruction
49845a5df465.plain:
At the end of the battle round, you score 1VP for each of these that happened this battle round (up to 4VP):
• One of your CHAOS KNIGHTS models destroyed 1 or more enemy units while it was wholly within your deployment zone.
• One of your CHAOS KNIGHTS models destroyed 1 or more enemy units while it was in neither player's deployment zone.
• One of your CHAOS KNIGHTS models destroyed 1 or more enemy units while it was wholly within your opponent's deployment zone.
• All 3 of the conditions above happened this battle round.

4a002c5d810a.name: Secure the Search Area
4a002c5d810a.plain: The search area is everything within 12" of the battlefield's centre. An objective marker labelled A that you control at the end of your Command phase stays yours even with none of your models in range, until your opponent controls it at the end of a later phase.

4a094eb2cf4c.name: Hidden Archeovault
4a094eb2cf4c.plain:
If you pick this, then in the Resolve Pre-battle Abilities step of the mission your opponent has to choose 1 objective marker outside their deployment zone to be the Hidden Archeovault. If there is only 1 objective marker on the battlefield and it is in their deployment zone, that marker has to be the Hidden Archeovault.
At the end of your turn, you score 5VP if the Hidden Archeovault is under your control and one of your ADEPTUS MECHANICUS units is within range of it.

4caac47837d3.name: Path of Destruction
4caac47837d3.plain:
When a battle round ends, gain 1 victory point for each of these that happened during that round (3 victory points at most):
• One of your CHAOS KNIGHTS models destroyed 1 or more enemy units while it was wholly within your deployment zone.
• One of your CHAOS KNIGHTS models destroyed 1 or more enemy units while it was more than 3" away from either player's deployment zone.
• One of your CHAOS KNIGHTS models destroyed 1 or more enemy units while it was wholly within your opponent's deployment zone.

4ee7ca946190.name: Ancient Machineries
4ee7ca946190.plain:
If you picked this, then once both sides have deployed, the players take turns choosing objective markers outside every deployment zone to be Ancient Machinery objective markers, with your opponent choosing first, until 3 have been chosen. If only 1 or 2 such markers exist, just those are Ancient Machinery objective markers.
Your NECRONS CORE or NECRONS CANOPTEK units can try this action.
Awaken Ancient Machinery (Action): 1 or more of your NECRONS CORE or NECRONS CANOPTEK units can start it at the end of your Movement phase. Each unit that starts it must be in range of a different Ancient Machinery objective marker from the others. No unit can start it while any enemy units (not counting AIRCRAFT) are in range of that same marker. It is completed at the end of your next Command phase, as long as the unit is still in range of that Ancient Machinery objective marker.
Each time one of your units completes this action, score 3 victory points.

4fd6d2c6223b.name: Ruthless Tyranny
4fd6d2c6223b.plain:
If you pick this, when your turn ends you gain victory points like this (4 victory points at most):
• 2 victory points if you control half or more of all the objective markers on the battlefield, and 1 or more of your CHAOS KNIGHTS models are within range of each of those markers.
• 1 victory point if half or more of all the objective markers on the battlefield are within Dread range of 1 or more of your CHAOS KNIGHTS models.
• 1 victory point if all objective markers on the battlefield are within Dread range of 1 or more of your CHAOS KNIGHTS models.

5199d8b6e00b.name: Spread the Sickness
5199d8b6e00b.plain:
If you pick this, your DEATH GUARD INFANTRY units can attempt this action.
Spread the Sickness (Action): at the end of your Movement phase, 1 of your DEATH GUARD INFANTRY units can start this action if it is within range of an objective marker that you control and that your army hasn't contaminated yet. The action completes at the end of your turn. When it completes, if the unit that did it has the Objective Secured ability, your army has contaminated that objective marker. If not, roll a D6: on a 4+, your army has contaminated that objective marker.
You score 3VP each time your army contaminates an objective marker in your deployment zone, and 4VP each time your army contaminates an objective marker outside your deployment zone.

51da523eda2e.name: A Leap of Faith
51da523eda2e.plain: At the end of each turn, if your ADEPTA SORORITAS units performed 2 Acts of Faith during that turn, score victory points: 1 if it is your turn, or 2 if it is your opponent's turn. If they performed 3 or more Acts of Faith during that turn, score 1 more victory point. Acts of Faith caused by Cherub dice from incensor cherubs don't count for this secondary objective. This secondary objective can give you no more than 12 victory points in the mission.

51f90d689120.name: Direct Assault
51f90d689120.plain: In battle rounds 2, 3 and 4, at the end of each Command phase, the player whose turn it is gets 4VP for every one of these they meet, to a maximum of 12VP: controlling 1 or more objective markers; controlling 2 or more; controlling more objective markers than the opponent. In battle round 5, the player who took the first turn scores this at the end of their Command phase as normal, but the player who took the second turn scores it at the end of their turn instead. Also, in every battle round, at the end of each turn, the player whose turn it is scores 2VP if one of these is true, or 3VP if both are: (a) they control every objective marker, or they control at least 1 objective marker they didn't control when their turn began; (b) they destroyed at least 1 enemy unit that was in range of an objective marker when their turn began.

5298102d776e.name: Sorcerous Prowess
5298102d776e.plain: At the end of the battle, score victory points for each enemy PSYKER unit that one of your THOUSAND SONS PSYKER units destroyed in the Psychic phase: 5 victory points if it was a PSYKER CHARACTER unit, and 3 victory points for any other PSYKER unit.

529841a999f8.name: Accretion of Knowledge
529841a999f8.plain:
At the end of the battle, you score 3VP for every destroyed enemy model that matches at least 1 of these:
• It has a Warlord Trait.
• It has a Relic.
• It is a VEHICLE model with a Wounds characteristic of 8 or more.

52e5b0b5d4b1.name: Leading From the Front
52e5b0b5d4b1.plain: At the start of every Command phase, a player whose WARLORD isn't on the battlefield (or embarked in a TRANSPORT model that is on the battlefield) rolls one D6: on a 1-3, that player doesn't get the Battle-forged CP bonus this phase.

55ae7853adeb.name: Prime Explosives
55ae7853adeb.plain: Both players' units can do these actions. Prime Explosives (Action): at the end of your Movement phase, 1 of your units that is wholly within your opponent's territory and more than 9" from every Primed Explosives objective marker can start it. A unit with Objective Secured or a similar rule completes it at the end of your turn; any other unit completes it at the end of your next Command phase. When it's completed, place 1 Primed Explosives objective marker wholly within your opponent's territory and wholly within 3" of that unit. This marker counts as an objective marker only for the Defuse Explosives action and the Detonation primary objective.

581c27474ce6.name: Purifying Ritual
581c27474ce6.plain:
Purifying Ritual (Psychic Action - Warp Charge 5): in your Psychic phase, any number of your units can do this. One of your GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER units within 3" of an objective marker can try to purify that marker with this psychic action. No objective marker can be purified more than once in the same turn.
At the end of the battle round, score victory points based on how many of your units completed this psychic action successfully that battle round (the table counts purified objectives): 1 gives 1 victory point, 2 give 2, 3 give 4, and 4 or more give 6.

waive.PURIFYING RITUAL NUMBER OF PURIFIED OBJE: a heading of the scoring table, not a keyword
waive.VICTORY POINTS SCORED: a heading of the scoring table, not a keyword
waive.4+: the table's last row, "4+", means 4 or more; written out as "4 or more"

5874e8c593eb.name: Surgical Assault
5874e8c593eb.plain: At the end of your turn: 5 victory points if the objective marker in your opponent's deployment zone is under your control.

5cbda572759c.name: Weave Veil
5cbda572759c.plain:
If you pick this, your SHADOWSEER units can attempt this psychic action.
Weave Veil (Psychic Action - Warp Charge 4): in your Psychic phase, 1 of your SHADOWSEER models can attempt it if it is within 18" of an enemy unit your army hasn't veiled yet. If it is completed, pick 1 enemy unit your army hasn't veiled yet that is within 18" of the SHADOWSEER model that completed it. Your army has now veiled that enemy unit, and for the rest of the battle the warp charge value of this psychic action goes up by 1 for your army.
Score 3VP each time one of your units completes this psychic action.

5f0ff26776d0.name: Stand Vigil
5f0ff26776d0.plain: At the end of the battle round, you score 3VP if the number of objective markers you control outside both players' deployment zones is higher than the number your opponent controls there.

61c9f93934d5.name: Broodswarm
61c9f93934d5.plain:
At the end of your turn, check these and score 1 victory point for every one that is true (4 victory points at most):
• Your opponent's deployment zone holds more of your models than of theirs.
• Your own deployment zone holds more of your models than of theirs.
• Outside both deployment zones, you have more models on the battlefield than your opponent.
• All 3 of the points above are true.

624437791fa5.name: Wrath of Khaine
624437791fa5.plain:
When a battle round ends, score for each of these that is true for that round:
• 1 victory point if a melee attack by one of your ASPECT WARRIOR units destroyed 1 or more enemy units.
• 1 victory point if a ranged attack by a different one of your ASPECT WARRIOR units destroyed 1 or more enemy units.
• 2 victory points if both of the above are true.

62576b6e362f.name: Heroic Challenge
62576b6e362f.plain:
At the start of the first Command phase, you must pick one of your SPACE WOLVES CHARACTER models to issue the challenge, and your opponent must pick one of their CHARACTER models to accept it. A player with no CHARACTER model must pick their WARLORD instead. At the end of the battle, score 5 victory points for each of these that happened:
• The model that accepted the challenge was destroyed.
• That model was destroyed by a melee attack.
• That model was destroyed by a melee attack from the model that issued the challenge.

6269d371c8a3.name: Mutate Landscape
6269d371c8a3.plain:
If you pick this, your THOUSAND SONS PSYKER units can try this psychic action.
Mutate Landscape (Psychic Action - Warp Charge 4): in your Psychic phase, one of your PSYKER units can try it if it is within range of an objective marker your army hasn't mutated yet. If it succeeds, that marker has been mutated by your army, and for the rest of the battle the warp charge value of this psychic action goes up by 1 for your army.
Score 3 victory points each time one of your units completes the Mutate Landscape psychic action.

waive.40000: part of the book title "Warhammer 40,000 Core Book"

62ab6760fd91.name: We March for Macragge
62ab6760fd91.plain:
If you pick this, your ULTRAMARINES CORE INFANTRY units can do this action. Claimed for Macragge (Action): at the end of your Movement phase, 1 or more of your ULTRAMARINES CORE INFANTRY units can start it. Each unit that starts it must be in range of a different objective marker that you control and that your army hasn't claimed for Macragge. It is completed when your next Command phase starts, or when the battle ends if that is sooner. Once it is completed, your army has claimed that marker for Macragge.

Score 4VP each time one of your units completes this action.

63000a34ba65.name: A Mighty Saga
63000a34ba65.plain:
If you pick this, at the end of each battle round, score 2 victory points for each of these your SPACE WOLVES WARLORD achieved, up to a maximum of 5 victory points:
• A melee attack by this WARLORD made an enemy MONSTER or VEHICLE unit lose any wounds.
• A melee attack by this WARLORD destroyed an enemy MONSTER or VEHICLE unit.
• A melee attack by this WARLORD destroyed an enemy CHARACTER.
• Attacks by this WARLORD destroyed 5 or more models.
• At the start of your Command phase, this WARLORD was within range of an objective marker wholly within your opponent's deployment zone.

63315036a1a7.name: Teleport Assault
63315036a1a7.plain: At the end of the battle round, score 5VP if 1 or more enemy units were destroyed by one of your GREY KNIGHTS models that was set up on the battlefield with the Gate of Infinity psychic power, the Teleport Strike ability or the Teleportation Shunt Stratagem this battle round.

6334cd271e44.name: Eradication of Flesh
6334cd271e44.plain: When a battle round ends, gain 3 victory points if both are true: at least 1 ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE unit from your army is on the battlefield, and in that round your ADEPTUS MECHANICUS units destroyed more enemy INFANTRY units than the number of your VEHICLE units destroyed by enemy units.

639655920b51.name: Precious Objectives
639655920b51.plain: After deployment zones are chosen and before reserves and transports are declared, the objective markers labelled A and B are moved. First the Attacker moves 1 marker labelled A or B; second, the Defender moves 1 marker labelled A and 1 labelled B (no marker can be moved twice); last, the Attacker moves the remaining A or B marker that hasn't been moved. Each moved marker must end wholly within 6" horizontally of where it started, and not on or in any Obstacles or Defensible Terrain feature. Then each player secretly writes down 1 objective marker in their opponent's territory as a Priority objective marker (not the one in the centre of the battlefield). Both players reveal their choice once both armies are deployed.

640473911e77.name: A Deadly Performance
640473911e77.plain:
At the end of your turn, score 3VP if at least 2 of these are true:
• You control an objective marker that you didn't control at the start of the turn, and one of your HARLEQUINS units is within range of it.
• One of your HARLEQUINS CORE units is wholly within your opponent's deployment zone.
• This turn, attacks with ranged weapons by your HARLEQUINS models destroyed 2 or more enemy units.
• This turn, attacks with melee weapons by your HARLEQUINS models destroyed 2 or more enemy units.

641729904d03.name: Yield No Ground
641729904d03.plain:
Not scored in the first battle round. If you pick this, at the end of your turn, score victory points like this, up to 5 victory points in total:
• 2 victory points if you control at least half of all the objective markers on the battlefield, and each of those markers has 1 or more of your IMPERIAL KNIGHTS models within range.
• 2 victory points if no enemy units (not counting AIRCRAFT units) are wholly within your deployment zone.
• 1 victory point as long as none of your IMPERIAL KNIGHTS units finished that turn nearer to your battlefield edge than where they started it, and none of your IMPERIAL KNIGHTS units Fell Back that turn.

66e62d841f43.name: For the Dark Gods
66e62d841f43.plain:
If you pick this, keep a For the Dark Gods tally. Each time one of your units completes the action below, it dedicates a table quarter to a Chaos God, and you add 1 to the tally.
For the Dark Gods (Action): at the end of your Movement phase, 1 of your TRAITORIS ASTARTES INFANTRY or TRAITORIS ASTARTES BIKER units can start this action if it is wholly within a table quarter your army hasn't dedicated to a Chaos God, and it is within 6" of that quarter's centre. A unit that had the Objective Secured ability when it began the action completes it at the end of your turn; any other unit completes it at the start of your next Command phase. Either way, the unit must still be within 6" of the same table quarter's centre for it to complete. Once completed, pick Khorne, Tzeentch, Nurgle or Slaanesh, and dedicate that table quarter to that god. If the unit that completed it is a KHORNE, TZEENTCH, NURGLE or SLAANESH unit, it can only pick its own patron deity (for example, a KHORNE unit can only pick Khorne). Your army has now dedicated that table quarter to that Chaos God. Your army can't dedicate the same table quarter to more than 1 Chaos God.
While one of your TRAITORIS ASTARTES units is wholly within a table quarter your army has dedicated to a Chaos God, add 2 to that unit's Leadership characteristic, unless that god isn't its patron deity (for example, in a table quarter dedicated to KHORNE, TZEENTCH, NURGLE and SLAANESH units don't get this bonus).
When the battle ends, you score VP based on your For the Dark Gods tally:
• Tally of 1: 2VP.
• Tally of 2: 5VP.
• Tally of 3: 9VP.
• Tally of 4: 14VP.

67815f08d491.name: Assassinate
67815f08d491.plain: At the end of the battle, score 3 victory points for each enemy CHARACTER model that has been destroyed.

679e7c1b8806.name: Rise to Glory
679e7c1b8806.plain:
If you pick this, at the end of each battle round, look at the CHARACTER, MONSTER or VEHICLE models that melee attacks from your TRAITORIS ASTARTES CHARACTER models destroyed in that battle round, and score 2 victory points for each one. For a destroyed model with a Wounds characteristic of 10 to 19, score 1 extra victory point; or score 2 extra victory points instead if it had the TITANIC keyword or was the enemy WARLORD. This secondary objective can't give you more than 5 victory points in a battle round.
Also, each time a melee attack from one of your TRAITORIS ASTARTES CHARACTER models destroys a CHARACTER, MONSTER or VEHICLE model, roll 2D6. If the total is lower than the destroyed model's Wounds characteristic, you get 1 Command point when the phase ends.

67fa32423fd8.name: Destroy the Daemon
67fa32423fd8.plain:
If you pick this, you score victory points for each unit that your GREY KNIGHTS units destroy during the battle:
• 5 victory points for a DAEMON PRIMARCH unit.
• 3 victory points for any other DAEMON MONSTER unit.
• 3 victory points for a DAEMON VEHICLE unit.
• 1 victory point for any other DAEMON unit.

68a87896fbf8.name: Grind Them Down
68a87896fbf8.plain: At the end of each battle round: gain 3VP if, during that battle round, more enemy units were destroyed than friendly units. Also, if your Troops, ARMIGER-CLASS or WAR DOG-CLASS units destroyed 1 or more enemy units this battle round, you gain 1 CP.

68d8368b512c.name: Wisdom is the Cornerstone of Faith
68d8368b512c.plain: In battle rounds 2, 3 and 4, at the end of each Command phase, the player whose turn it is gets 4VP for every one of these they meet, to a maximum of 12VP: controlling 1 or more objective markers; controlling 2 or more; controlling more objective markers than the opponent. In battle round 5, the player who took the first turn scores this at the end of their Command phase as normal, but the player who took the second turn scores it at the end of their turn instead. Also, at the end of each of your turns (every battle round), if you're Player A: gain 2VP if you control objective marker B, lose 1VP if you don't control objective marker A, and gain 1VP for every other objective marker you control. If you're Player B, swap the letters: gain 2VP for objective marker A, lose 1VP for not controlling objective marker B, and gain 1VP per other objective marker. Your score never drops below 0.

6c28028601f7.name: Secret Intel Inbound
6c28028601f7.plain: Neither player gets a Battle-forged CP bonus in battle rounds 1 and 2. In battle rounds 4 and 5, at the start of each Command phase, the player whose turn it is gets 1 extra CP from their Battle-forged CP bonus, so they usually gain 2CP then.

6c91b597ac19.name: Storm of Darkness
6c91b597ac19.plain: If you pick this, your CHAOS KNIGHTS units can do this action. Storm of Darkness (Action): at the end of your Morale phase, 1 of your CHAOS KNIGHTS units can start it if it is in range of an objective marker your army hasn't cursed yet. It can't start while any enemy units (not counting AIRCRAFT) are in range of that marker. It is completed at the end of your next Psychic phase, as long as the unit is still within range of that marker. Once it is completed, your army has cursed that marker. For the rest of the battle, while a non-CHAOS unit is within 6" of that marker, the Leadership characteristic of each model in that unit is reduced by 1. Gain 3 victory points each time one of your units completes this action.

6ca15b306c46.name: Ascend
6ca15b306c46.plain: In battle rounds 2, 3 and 4, at the end of each Command phase, the player whose turn it is gets 4VP for every one of these they meet, to a maximum of 12VP: controlling 1 or more objective markers; controlling 2 or more; controlling more objective markers than the opponent. In battle round 5, the player who took the first turn scores this at the end of their Command phase as normal, but the player who took the second turn scores it at the end of their turn instead. Also, at the end of each of your turns (every battle round), you get 2VP if you control the centre objective marker or if you destroyed at least 1 enemy unit that started the turn within 6" of the battlefield's centre (2VP at most, even if both are true). Then, when the battle ends, each player gets 3VP if their WARLORD is in range of the centre objective marker, and another 3VP if the opposing WARLORD has been destroyed.

6cdabd1639a1.name: Oaths of Moment
6cdabd1639a1.plain:
If you pick this, at the end of each battle round you score victory points for completing these 3 Oaths:
• Oath of Valour: 1 victory point if one of your ADEPTUS ASTARTES units destroyed any CHARACTER, VEHICLE or MONSTER unit during that battle round.
• Oath of Honour: 1 victory point as long as none of your ADEPTUS ASTARTES units failed a Morale test, and none of them Fell Back during that battle round.
• Oath of Duty: 2 victory points if one of your ADEPTUS ASTARTES units is wholly within 6" of the battlefield's centre.

6de3eb99248b.name: Inload Data-psalm
6de3eb99248b.plain: Both players' units can do this action. Inload Data-psalm (Action): at the end of your Movement phase, 1 or more of your units can start it, each in range of a different objective marker. A unit can't start it while any enemy unit other than AIRCRAFT is in range of that objective marker. It is completed at the end of your next Command phase if the unit is still in range of the same objective marker. If a unit with Objective Secured completes it, that objective marker stays under its player's control even with none of their models in range, until the opponent controls it at the end of a later phase.

70d4dc926e7b.name: Sorcerous Prowess
70d4dc926e7b.plain:
At the end of the battle, for each enemy unit that one of your THOUSAND SONS PSYKER units destroyed in the Psychic phase, score:
• 5VP if it was a PSYKER CHARACTER unit.
• 3VP if it was any other PSYKER unit.
• 2VP if it was any other unit.

72429aff5fc1.name: Get Da Good Bitz
72429aff5fc1.plain:
If you pick this, your ORKS CORE units can do this action. Get da Good Bitz (Action): 1 or more of your ORKS CORE units can start it at the end of your Movement phase. Each unit that starts it must be in range of a different objective marker that you control and that is not in either player's deployment zone. When a LOOTAS or GRETCHIN unit is doing it, it is completed at the end of your turn. Any other unit completes it when your next Command phase starts, or when the battle ends if that is sooner. Either way, it is only completed if the unit is still in range of that same marker.

Score 4VP each time one of your units completes this action, up to a maximum of 6VP each battle round.

7310149f0359.name: Broodswarm
7310149f0359.plain:
At the end of your turn, you score 1VP for each of these that is true (up to 5VP):
• More of your models than your opponent's are wholly within your opponent's deployment zone.
• More of your models than your opponent's are wholly within your deployment zone.
• More of your models than your opponent's are on the battlefield and wholly within no man's land.

739ef2f73408.name: Bring It Down
739ef2f73408.plain: When the battle ends, gain victory points for each enemy MONSTER or VEHICLE model that has been destroyed: 2 victory points if its Wounds characteristic was 10 or lower, 3 victory points if it was 11 or higher.

73e7aedd5e13.name: No Prisoners
73e7aedd5e13.plain: Keep a Kill Points tally if you pick this. Each time an enemy model is destroyed, unless it is a VEHICLE, MONSTER or CHARACTER model, add marks to the tally equal to its Wounds characteristic. At the end of the battle, divide your tally by 10, rounding down: that's how many VP you score. You also score 1 extra VP if your tally is 50-99, or 2 extra VP if it's 100 or more.

7420f74f4ca0.name: Psychic Interrogation
7420f74f4ca0.plain: Score 3VP each time you complete this psychic action. Psychic Interrogation (Psychic Action - Warp Charge 5): in your Psychic phase, 1 PSYKER CHARACTER unit from your army that is within 24" of an enemy CHARACTER unit and can see it can attempt it. Also, if the Psychic test result equals or beats the Leadership characteristic of any enemy CHARACTER model within 24" of the PSYKER unit that completed it, you gain 1 CP at the end of the phase.

74cade33e000.name: Ruthless Tyranny
74cade33e000.plain:
At the end of your turn:
• You score 2VP if you control at least half of all the objective markers on the battlefield and each of those markers has at least 1 of your CHAOS KNIGHTS models within range.
• You score 1VP if at least half of all the objective markers on the battlefield are in Dread range of at least 1 of your CHAOS KNIGHTS models.
• You score 2VP if each objective marker on the battlefield is in Dread range of at least 1 of your CHAOS KNIGHTS models.

75e264547b4a.name: Spore Nodes
75e264547b4a.plain:
If you pick this, your HIVE TENDRIL Troops units can do this action. Seed Spore Node (Action): from the second battle round onwards, at the end of your Movement phase, 1 of your HIVE TENDRIL Troops units can start it if it is not within 6" of any Spore Node objective markers and is within 6" of your opponent's deployment zone. It is completed at the end of your turn. Once it is completed, place 1 objective marker anywhere within 1" of the unit that did it. That marker is a Spore Node. It only counts as an objective marker for this secondary objective, not for any other rules.

Score 4VP each time one of your units completes this action.

76e9c81ddefa.name: Fear and Terror

787caefe35b0.name: Glory Kills
787caefe35b0.plain:
If you pick this, you score victory points like this:
• 2 victory points if one of your SPACE WOLVES units destroyed any CHARACTER units during this battle round. If no CHARACTER units were destroyed, but attacks from your SPACE WOLVES units made a CHARACTER unit suffer 3 or more wounds, score 1 victory point instead.
• 3 victory points if one of your SPACE WOLVES units destroyed any MONSTER units during this battle round. If no MONSTER units were destroyed, but attacks from your SPACE WOLVES units made a MONSTER unit suffer 3 or more wounds, score 1 victory point instead.
A CHARACTER MONSTER unit can't count for both parts. You must choose whether it counts as a CHARACTER or a MONSTER for this objective.

7b458e584aa8.name: The Hidden Path
7b458e584aa8.plain:
If you pick this and your army has a WEBWAY GATE unit, you can't set that unit up within 6" of your deployment zone. If your army has no WEBWAY GATE unit, pick 1 objective marker in your first Command phase that isn't within 6" of your deployment zone. Then, at the end of each of your Command phases:
• With a WEBWAY GATE unit: gain victory points equal to the current battle round number if one of your units (not a WEBWAY GATE unit) is within 3" of that WEBWAY GATE unit and no enemy models are within 3" of it.
• Without a WEBWAY GATE unit: gain victory points equal to the current battle round number if you control the picked objective marker with one of your ASURYANI units.

7c254743bba3.name: A Clean Victory
7c254743bba3.plain:
If you chose the Mont'ka Tactical Philosophy at the start of the battle, this scores at the end of battle rounds 1, 2 and 3. If you chose the Kauyon Tactical Philosophy at the start of the battle instead, it scores at the end of battle rounds 3, 4 and 5. In each of those battle rounds you can score both of these:
• 1 victory point if 1 or more enemy units were destroyed in that battle round.
• 3 victory points if 3 or more enemy units were destroyed in that battle round.

7e28768d5af8.name: Sweep and Clear
7e28768d5af8.plain: An objective marker you control at the end of your Command phase stays yours even with none of your models in range, until your opponent controls it at the end of a later phase.

7fceaf1b7294.name: Eradication of Flesh
7fceaf1b7294.plain: At the end of the battle round, compare 2 counts for this battle round: the enemy units your ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE units destroyed, and your ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE units that enemy units destroyed. Score 4VP if the first count is higher.

7fd2a1a89774.name: Specimens for the Spider
7fd2a1a89774.plain:
At the end of the battle round:
• Score 3VP if a melee attack made by one of your CREATIONS OF BILE models destroyed 1 or more CHARACTER or MONSTER units this battle round.
• Score 2VP if a melee attack made by one of your CREATIONS OF BILE models destroyed 1 or more units that aren't CHARACTER, MONSTER or VEHICLE units this battle round.
At the end of the battle, score 1 extra VP if a melee attack made by one of your CREATIONS OF BILE models destroyed 1 or more ADEPTUS ASTARTES, SANCTIC ASTARTES or HERETIC ASTARTES units during the battle.

8233f83d3198.name: Renew the Oaths
8233f83d3198.plain:
If you pick this, your IMPERIAL KNIGHTS units can do this action. Renew the Oaths (Action): at the end of your Movement phase, 1 of your IMPERIAL KNIGHTS models can start it if it is within 6" of the centre of the battlefield. It is completed at the end of your turn if the unit doing it is still within 6" of the battlefield's centre.

Each time one of your units completes this action:
• Score 3VP if a non-TITANIC model completed it.
• Score 4VP if a TITANIC model completed it.
• Score 1 more VP if a CHARACTER model completed it.
• Roll one D6: on a 4+, you gain 1 Honour point.

849c36d852f4.name: Wrath of Khaine
849c36d852f4.plain:
At the end of the battle round:
• Score 1VP if a ranged attack made by one of your ASPECT WARRIOR units destroyed 1 or more enemy units this battle round.
• Score 1VP if a melee attack made by a different one of your ASPECT WARRIOR units destroyed 1 or more enemy units this battle round.
• Score 2VP if you achieved both of the above this battle round.

84fe684405bd.name: Prospects of Wealth
84fe684405bd.plain:
If you pick this, your VOTANN INFANTRY and VOTANN BIKER units can do this action. Prospect (Action): at the end of your Movement phase, 1 of your VOTANN INFANTRY or VOTANN BIKER units can start it if it is in range of an objective marker that your army hasn't prospected yet and that is not within your deployment zone. It can't start while any enemy units (not counting AIRCRAFT units) are in range of that same marker. It is completed at the end of the turn. Once it is completed, your army has prospected that marker. Then roll one D6, adding 1 to the roll if the unit that did it has the SCANNER keyword. On a 6+, the marker becomes a Rich Deposits objective marker.

Each time one of your units completes this action, score 3VP. At the end of the battle, score 3VP more if you control at least 1 Rich Deposits marker.

8a18050a7a14.name: Objective Purged
8a18050a7a14.plain: An objective marker you control at the end of your Command phase, while at least one of your units in range of it has Objective Secured, stays yours even with none of your models in range, until your opponent controls it at the end of a later phase.

8a920e765e76.name: Scout the Enemy
8a920e765e76.plain:
Your units can do this action. Scout the Enemy (Action): at the end of your Movement phase, 1 of your units can start it if it isn't within 6" of your deployment zone. If a RANGERS unit is doing it, it is completed at the end of the turn. For any other unit, it is completed at the start of your next turn. Once it is completed:
• Gain 2 victory points if the unit is not wholly within your opponent's deployment zone.
• Gain 4 victory points if the unit is wholly within your opponent's deployment zone.

8b29b873b644.name: Storm of Darkness
8b29b873b644.plain:
If you pick this, your CHAOS KNIGHTS units can attempt this action.
Storm of Darkness (Action): at the end of your Morale phase, 1 of your CHAOS KNIGHTS units can start this action if it is within range of an objective marker your army hasn't cursed yet. A unit can't start it while any enemy units (not counting AIRCRAFT units) are within range of that same objective marker. It completes at the end of your next Psychic phase, as long as the unit is still within range of that same objective marker. Once completed, your army has cursed that objective marker. For the rest of the battle, subtract 1 from the Leadership characteristic of models in any non-CHAOS unit while that unit is within 9" of that objective marker.
You score 4VP each time one of your units completes this action.

8b39d84252ac.name: Raid and Reave
8b39d84252ac.plain:
If you pick this, your RED CORSAIRS INFANTRY and RED CORSAIRS BIKER units can do this action. Raid and Reave (Action): at the end of your Movement phase, 1 or more of your RED CORSAIRS INFANTRY or RED CORSAIRS BIKER units can start it. Each unit that starts it must be in range of a different objective marker that your army hasn't raided. A unit can't start it while any enemy units (not counting AIRCRAFT units) are in range of that same marker. It is completed at the end of your turn if the unit is still in range of that same marker. Once it is completed, your army has raided that marker, and the unit that did the action is carrying spoils of war until the battle ends.

Each time one of your units completes this action, score VP depending on where the raided marker was:
• Wholly within your deployment zone: 1VP.
• Wholly within your opponent's deployment zone: 3VP.
• Anywhere else: 2VP.

When the battle ends, score 1VP for each of your RED CORSAIRS units carrying spoils of war. Score 2VP instead for such a unit if it is wholly within your deployment zone, or if it is embarked within a TRANSPORT model that is wholly within your deployment zone.

8bb8b32cc6e1.name: Shock Tactics
8bb8b32cc6e1.plain: At the end of the battle round, score 3 victory points if you control 1 or more objective markers that your opponent controlled when the battle round started, and one of your ADEPTUS ASTARTES units is within range of that marker.

8ca018eab209.name: Scout the Enemy
8ca018eab209.plain:
Your ASURYANI units can attempt this action.
Scout the Enemy (Action): 1 of your ASURYANI units can start this action at the end of your Movement phase, as long as it isn't within 6" of your deployment zone. A RANGERS unit completes it at the end of the turn. Any other unit completes it when your next Command phase starts or when the battle ends, whichever comes first. When it is completed:
• You score 2VP if the unit doing it isn't wholly within your opponent's deployment zone.
