• You score 4VP if the unit doing it is wholly within your opponent's deployment zone.

8eabfdf5b499.name: Burn Empires
8eabfdf5b499.plain:
If you pick this, your THOUSAND SONS INFANTRY units can do this action. Burn Empires (Action): at the end of your Movement phase, 1 or more of your THOUSAND SONS INFANTRY units (not CHARACTER units) can start it. Each unit that starts it must be in range of a different objective marker that you control, that is not within your deployment zone, and that your army hasn't burned. It is completed when your next Command phase starts, or when the battle ends if that is sooner. Once it is completed, your army has burned that marker.

Score 4VP each time one of your units completes this action.

8f3b28c7761a.name: Stubborn Defiance
8f3b28c7761a.plain:
In your first Command phase, pick 1 objective marker. From your second Command phase on, at the end of each of your Command phases, if you control that marker with one of your DARK ANGELS units that has the Objective Secured ability, gain victory points based on how many of your Command phases in a row you have controlled it with that unit:
• 2 in a row: 2 victory points.
• 3 in a row: 3 victory points.
• 4 in a row: 5 victory points.
• 5 in a row: 5 victory points.
For example, if in your third Command phase you have controlled that marker with a DARK ANGELS unit for 3 of your Command phases in a row, you gain 3 victory points that turn.

waive.CONSECUTIVE NUMBER OF YOUR COMMAND PHASE: a heading of the scoring table, not a keyword

902d4b877a01.name: Oaths of Moment
902d4b877a01.plain:
At the end of the battle round, score VP for each of these 3 Oaths you fulfil:
• Oath of Valour: score 1VP if one of your ADEPTUS ASTARTES units destroyed any CHARACTER, VEHICLE or MONSTER unit this battle round.
• Oath of Honour: score 1VP if none of your ADEPTUS ASTARTES units failed a Morale test this battle round and none of them Fell Back this battle round.
• Oath of Duty: score 2VP if one of your ADEPTUS ASTARTES units is wholly within 6" of the battlefield's centre.

912849423e1b.name: Binharic Interference
912849423e1b.plain: Reinforcement units can't be set up within range of any objective marker in this mission.

92ea69cff21a.name: Herd the Prey
92ea69cff21a.plain: At the end of your turn, you score 1VP for every table quarter that has no enemy units wholly within it (AIRCRAFT units don't count).

93c83be0561d.name: Purge the Vermin
93c83be0561d.plain:
You can't score this in the first battle round. When your turn ends:
• Score 1VP for every table quarter with no enemy units (not counting AIRCRAFT units) in it.
• Score 1VP if your deployment zone has no enemy units (not counting AIRCRAFT units) within it.

94030eccbd1d.name: Auric Mortalis
94030eccbd1d.plain:
If you pick this, before the battle you mark 1 unit in your opponent's army for death. It must have the PRIMARCH or SUPREME COMMANDER keyword. If they have no such unit, mark their unit with the highest points value instead. Ignore AIRCRAFT units when choosing.
At the end of the battle, add up your victory points for this objective (the total can't go below 0):
• 5 victory points if the marked unit was destroyed.
• 5 victory points if the marked unit was destroyed by a melee attack from one of your ADEPTUS CUSTODES or ANATHEMA PSYKANA units.
• 5 victory points if both of the above apply and the marked unit was more than 6" away from your deployment zone when it was destroyed.
• -2 victory points for each of your units that the marked unit destroyed.

986921275120.name: Cranial Feasting
986921275120.plain:
Each time a melee attack by one of your HIVE TENDRIL models destroys an enemy CHARACTER model or unit champion, roll one D6. Add 1 to the roll if your HIVE TENDRIL model has the FEEDER TENDRILS keyword, and add 2 if the model it destroyed has the CHARACTER keyword. If the result is 6+, gain 1 Command point.

When the battle ends:
• Score 3VP if this secondary objective gained you 1 or more Command points during the battle.
• Score 1VP for each enemy unit champion destroyed by a melee attack from one of your HIVE TENDRIL models.
• Score 3VP for each enemy CHARACTER unit destroyed by a melee attack from one of your HIVE TENDRIL models.
• Score 3VP more if the enemy WARLORD was destroyed by a melee attack from one of your FEEDER TENDRILS models.

9ae6876dd547.name: Stomp ’Em Good
9ae6876dd547.plain:
If you pick this, at the end of each battle round you can score:
• 3 victory points if, during that battle round, melee attacks by your ORKS units destroyed more enemy units than the number of your non-GRETCHIN units that melee attacks destroyed.
• 1 more victory point if, during that battle round, the number of enemy units destroyed by melee attacks from your ORKS units is at least 2 and is at least double the number of your non-GRETCHIN units that melee attacks destroyed.

9bc0b4c3126d.name: Secure Landing Sites
9bc0b4c3126d.plain: In battle rounds 2, 3 and 4, at the end of each Command phase, the player whose turn it is gets 4VP for every one of these they meet, to a maximum of 12VP: controlling 1 or more objective markers; controlling 2 or more; controlling more objective markers than the opponent. In battle round 5, the player who took the first turn scores this at the end of their Command phase as normal, but the player who took the second turn scores it at the end of their turn instead. Also, in battle rounds 3, 4 and 5, at the end of each turn, the player whose turn it is scores VP for every objective marker they control in no man's land: 2VP each in battle round 3, 3VP each in round 4 and 4VP each in round 5.

waive.VP PER OBJECTIVE MARKER IN NO MAN'S LAND: a table column heading, not a keyword

9f5f6dfba528.name: Death on the Wind
9f5f6dfba528.plain: Gain 2 victory points each time an attack by one of your RAVENWING models destroys an enemy unit, if that model moved 12" or more in that turn's Movement phase or made a charge move that turn.

a1285922cfd1.name: Land Purged
a1285922cfd1.plain: An objective marker you control at the end of your Command phase, while at least one of your units in range of it has Objective Secured, stays yours even with none of your models in range, until your opponent controls it at the end of a later phase.

waive.40: part of the book title "Warhammer 40,000 Core Book"
waive.40000: part of the book title "Warhammer 40,000 Core Book"
waive.000: part of the book title "Warhammer 40,000 Core Book"

a371496499ed.name: Honour of the House
a371496499ed.plain:
At the end of the battle round, score 2VP if you have 6 Honour points, or if your Honour points total is higher than it was when that battle round began.

Also, at the end of the battle:
• If your army is Virtuous, score 3 more VP.
• If your army is Honoured, score 2 more VP.
• If your army is Dishonoured, take 3 off the VP you have scored from this secondary objective (it can't go below 0).

a4729d913e12.name: Domination
a4729d913e12.plain: At the end of your turn, gain 3 victory points when you control over half of all the objective markers on the battlefield.

a70f308dcaa7.name: Wrath of Magnus
a70f308dcaa7.plain: You can only pick this if your opponent's army has 1 or more PSYKER units. At the end of the battle round, score 3 victory points if psychic powers destroyed more enemy models than friendly models during that battle round.

a81d9dee5c3c.name: Aerospace Targeting Relays
a81d9dee5c3c.plain:
If you pick this, put an Aerospace Designation marker halfway along each battlefield edge.
Your units can do this action.
Install Targeting Relay (Action): at the end of your Movement phase, 1 or more of your INFANTRY units can start it. Each unit that starts it needs to be within 6" of the centre of an Aerospace Designation marker with no targeting relay installed yet, with each unit at a different marker. It is completed at the start of your next Command phase, or when the battle ends if that comes first. When it is completed, a targeting relay has been installed at that Aerospace Designation marker.
At the end of the battle, score victory points by the number of installed targeting relays: 1 gives 2 victory points, 2 gives 6, 3 gives 9 and 4 gives 15.

waive.TARGETING RELAYS NUMBER OF TARGETING REL: a heading of the scoring table, not a keyword

a8677f1ce6e2.name: Stomp’em Good
a8677f1ce6e2.plain:
At the end of the battle round:
• Score 3VP if melee attacks by your ORKS units destroyed more enemy units this battle round than the number of your non-GRETCHIN units that melee attacks destroyed this battle round.
• Score 1 more VP if the enemy units that melee attacks by your ORKS units destroyed this battle round number at least 2, and also at least twice as many as your non-GRETCHIN units that melee attacks destroyed this battle round.

a879614f15c1.name: Behind Enemy Lines
a879614f15c1.plain: At the end of your turn, score 3VP if 1 unit from your army (not AIRCRAFT) is wholly within your opponent's deployment zone, or 4VP instead if 2 or more of your units (not AIRCRAFT) are. Also, if at least 1 of those units is a Troops, ARMIGER-CLASS or WAR DOG-CLASS unit, you gain 1 CP at the end of the current battle round.

ab8042e34e65.name: Grudge Match
ab8042e34e65.plain:
If you pick this, then before the battle you must choose 5 units from your opponent's army, including the enemy WARLORD, and note them on your army roster. If your opponent's army has 5 or fewer units, note all of them instead.
At the end of the battle, score 1 victory point for each noted unit that one of your VOTANN units destroyed. Score 1 more victory point if that unit's points cost was 150 or more, and/or 1 more if a melee attack destroyed it (up to 3 victory points per unit). A unit's points value counts all its weapons, other wargear and upgrades.
At the end of the battle, take 1 victory point off what this secondary objective earned you (it can't go below 0) for each noted unit that hasn't been destroyed. If a unit splits into several smaller units during the battle, it only counts as destroyed for this objective if all of those units (not counting DRONE units) are destroyed when the battle ends.

ac5eac45ad76.name: Supply Lines
ac5eac45ad76.plain: At the start of every Command phase, a player who doesn't control the objective marker in their own deployment zone rolls one D6: on a 1-3, that player doesn't get the Battle-forged CP bonus this phase.

adfdbae20ab6.name: Inflexible Command
adfdbae20ab6.plain:
At the end of your turn:
• Score 2VP if each of your PLATOON INFANTRY units on the battlefield is within 6" of one of your OFFICER units.
• Score 1VP if each of your SQUADRON units on the battlefield is within 12" of one of your OFFICER units.
• Score 2VP if one of your ASTRA MILITARUM units destroyed any enemy units this turn while it was affected by an Order.
For this secondary objective:
• While one of your OFFICER units is embarked within a TRANSPORT model, that TRANSPORT model also counts as having the OFFICER keyword.
• Your PLATOON VOX-CASTER units that are within 24" of any of your VOX-CASTER OFFICER units count as being within 6" instead.

ae2e32cfd3dc.name: Spore Nodes
ae2e32cfd3dc.plain:
Score 4 victory points each time one of your units successfully completes this action.
Seed Spore Node (Action): from the second battle round onwards, at the end of your Movement phase, one of your Troops units can start it if it is within 6" of your opponent's deployment zone, as long as no Spore Node objective markers are within 6" of it. It is completed at the end of your turn. When it is completed, place 1 objective marker anywhere within 1" of the unit that completed it. That marker is a Spore Node. It only counts as an objective marker for this secondary objective, not for any other rules.

b0c755b0c8c4.name: While We Stand, We Fight
b0c755b0c8c4.plain: If you pick this, before the battle note on your army roster the 3 units in your army with the highest points values, not counting models with the Fortifications Battlefield Role (if 2 or more are tied, you choose). If your army has 3 or fewer units, note all of them. A unit's points include all the weapons and wargear it has. At the end of the battle, score 5 VP for each of those units still on the battlefield. If a unit splits into smaller units during the battle, every one of those units must be destroyed before the original unit counts as destroyed for this objective.

b1f4b963602e.name: The Promethean Creed
b1f4b963602e.plain:
In your first Command phase, pick 1 objective marker that is not within your deployment zone.
• When each of your Command phases ends, score 2VP if you control that marker and one of your SALAMANDERS CORE INFANTRY units is in range of it.
• Each time an enemy unit is picked to shoot or fight, if it aims one or more of its attacks at one of your SALAMANDERS INFANTRY units that is in range of that marker, but those attacks don't destroy your unit, score 1VP (maximum 2VP per turn).
• At the end of every turn (yours and your opponent's), score 1VP if attacks by one of your SALAMANDERS INFANTRY units destroyed 1 or more enemy units that turn while your unit was in range of that marker. Score 2VP instead if any models in those destroyed units were destroyed by attacks with flame or melta weapons that turn.

b45fd240e5c0.name: Lay Claim
b45fd240e5c0.plain: If you pick this, then in the Resolve Pre-battle Abilities step of the mission your opponent sets up 3 objective markers anywhere on the battlefield. Each must be at ground level, not within 6" of their deployment zone or of any battlefield edge, and not within 9" of the others. None can go on a terrain feature with the Unstable Position terrain trait. If a marker can't be set up like this, it isn't set up. Each one is one of your Precious Resources. It only counts as an objective marker for this secondary objective, not for any other rules. At the end of the battle, score 5VP for each of your Precious Resources objective markers that you control.

b5339c4cedcb.name: Despoiled Ground
b5339c4cedcb.plain:
If you pick this, you gain victory points like this:
• When the battle ends, gain 4 victory points if you have 1 or more BUBONIC ASTARTES units wholly within your opponent's deployment zone and 1 or more BUBONIC ASTARTES units wholly within your own deployment zone.
• When the battle ends, gain 4 victory points if you have BUBONIC ASTARTES units wholly within 3 different table quarters (at least 1 in each) and all of those units are more than 6" from the centre of the battlefield. Gain 6 victory points instead if you have 1 or more of your BUBONIC ASTARTES units wholly within every table quarter, all of them more than 6" from the centre.
• When the battle ends, gain 4 victory points if you control more than half of all the objective markers on the battlefield and your BUBONIC ASTARTES units are within 3" of each of those markers.
• When the battle ends, gain 4 victory points if all objective markers on the battlefield are within Contagion range of a Contagion ability that your units have.

b551dd3098e5.name: Allow Not the Worship of Unclean Idols
b551dd3098e5.plain: When a battle round ends, gain 4 victory points if you control 1 or more objective markers that your opponent controlled at the start of that round, and one of your BLACK TEMPLARS CHAPLAIN units is within range of that marker.

b5fdde74bbbe.name: Surge of Faith
b5fdde74bbbe.plain: Both players' units can do this action. Surge of Faith (Action): at the start of your Movement phase, 1 of your units in range of an objective marker outside your deployment zone can start it (a unit with Objective Secured or a similar rule can start it at the end of your Movement phase instead). It can't start while any enemy unit other than AIRCRAFT is in range of that objective marker. It is completed at the end of your turn if the unit is still in range of the same objective marker.

b6b13d8f5750.name: Secure or Sabotage
b6b13d8f5750.plain:
If you pick this, your RAVEN GUARD units can do this action. Plant Explosives (Action): at the end of your Movement phase, 1 or more of your RAVEN GUARD CORE INFANTRY units can start it. Each unit that starts it must be in range of a different objective marker that you control and that your army hasn't already planted explosives on. It is completed at the end of your turn. Once it is completed, your army has planted explosives on that marker.

At the end of any player's turn, you can set off a controlled explosion with each objective marker that your army has planted explosives on and that your opponent controls. If you do, your explosives are no longer planted on that marker, and you roll one D6 for each unit in range of it: on a 2+, that unit suffers 3 mortal wounds. You can't set off a controlled explosion with a marker in the same turn your army planted explosives on it.

When the battle ends, score 3VP for every objective marker your army's explosives are still planted on.

b76d3e30865c.name: Prospects of Wealth
b76d3e30865c.plain:
If you pick this, your VOTANN INFANTRY and VOTANN BIKER units can try this action.
Prospect (Action): at the end of your Movement phase, one of your VOTANN INFANTRY or VOTANN BIKER units can start it if it is in range of an objective marker outside your deployment zone that your army hasn't prospected yet. It can't start while any enemy units (not counting AIRCRAFT units) are in range of that same objective marker. It is completed at the end of the turn. Once it is completed, your army has prospected that marker, and you must roll one D6. Add 1 to the roll if the unit that completed it has the SCANNER keyword. On a 6+, that marker becomes a Rich Deposits objective marker.
Score 3 victory points each time one of your units completes this action. At the end of the battle, score 3 more victory points if you control 1 or more Rich Deposits markers.

b8a337eae82c.name: By Lasgun and Bayonet
b8a337eae82c.plain: Score 1VP each time one of your ASTRA MILITARUM units destroys an enemy unit that was within range of an objective marker when the turn began.

b8ff57721c62.name: Investigate Sites
b8ff57721c62.plain: Score 3 victory points each time one of your units completes this action. Investigate Site (Action): at the end of your Movement phase, 1 INFANTRY unit from your army (other than CHARACTERS) within 6" of the centre of the battlefield can start it, as long as no enemy units other than AIRCRAFT are within 6" of the centre. It is completed at the end of your turn.

b94b3c631929.name: Carry Out Your Vows
b94b3c631929.plain:
You can only pick this if you have picked any Templar Vows. It has a Progressive part and an End Game part. For the End Game part, only the Templar Vow picked at the end of the Read Mission Briefing step counts, not any other vows picked during the battle.
Progressive: when a battle round ends, gain 4 victory points if the count of enemy units destroyed by melee attacks from your BLACK TEMPLARS units is higher than the count of your BLACK TEMPLARS units destroyed during that round. You can gain at most 12 victory points from this part over the battle.
End Game: when the battle ends, gain 3 victory points if any of these is true:
• You picked the Suffer Not the Unclean to Live vow before the battle, and a melee attack from one of your BLACK TEMPLARS CHARACTER units destroyed an enemy WARLORD model during the battle.
• You picked the Uphold the Honour of the Emperor vow before the battle, and when the battle ended one of your BLACK TEMPLARS INFANTRY units (not a CHARACTER unit) that isn't below Half-strength was in the enemy deployment zone.
• You picked the Abhor the Witch, Destroy the Witch vow before the battle, and 1 or more enemy PSYKER CHARACTER units were destroyed during the battle.
• You picked the Accept Any Challenge, No Matter the Odds vow before the battle, and during the battle either an enemy model with a Wounds characteristic of 20 or more, or an enemy unit whose Starting Strength was 20 or more models, was destroyed.

bad0fe50fca3.name: Yield No Ground
bad0fe50fca3.plain:
At the end of your turn, score 1VP for each of these you achieve (maximum 3VP):
• You control at least half of all the objective markers on the battlefield, and each of those markers has 1 or more of your IMPERIAL KNIGHTS models in range of it.
• There are no enemy units (not counting AIRCRAFT units) wholly within your deployment zone.
• None of your IMPERIAL KNIGHTS units finished the turn nearer to your battlefield edge than where they began it, and none of your IMPERIAL KNIGHTS units Fell Back this turn.

bb0c710e2e84.name: Green Tide
bb0c710e2e84.plain: When your turn ends, score 1VP for every table quarter containing 10 or more of your ORK models. Models within 3" of any other table quarter don't count towards this.

bbc95dc41a75.name: Cull Order
bbc95dc41a75.plain:
If you pick this, then in the Resolve Pre-battle Abilities step of the mission you choose 3 Battlefield Roles (HQ, Troops and so on) that units in your opponent's army have. If fewer than 3 different Battlefield Roles are found among your opponent's units, choose as many as you can.
At the end of the battle, for each Battlefield Role you chose: you score 3VP if at least 1 of your opponent's units with that role has been destroyed, or 5VP instead if all of your opponent's units with that role have been destroyed.

bc26cf6805a5.name: Take Your Places
bc26cf6805a5.plain:
If you pick this, once both sides have deployed, you set up 1 extra objective marker in your opponent's deployment zone. Then your opponent sets up 1 extra objective marker in your deployment zone and 1 more within 6" of the centre of the battlefield. Each of these markers must be set up more than 9" from the others, more than 6" from any battlefield edge and more than 1" from any other objective marker. These are the Take Your Places objective markers. They only count as objective markers for this secondary objective, not for any other rules.
• At the end of your turn, gain 2 victory points if you control 2 of the Take Your Places markers.
• At the end of your turn, gain 4 victory points instead if you control all 3 of them.

bf4c15e867de.name: Ancient Machineries
bf4c15e867de.plain:
If you pick this, your NECRONS CORE and NECRONS CANOPTEK units can do this action. Awaken Ancient Machinery (Action): 1 of your NECRONS CORE INFANTRY, NECRONS CORE BIKER or NECRONS CANOPTEK units can start it at the end of your Movement phase if it is in range of an objective marker that you control, that is not within your deployment zone, and that your army hasn't awakened yet. If the unit doing it has the Objective Secured ability, it is completed at the end of your turn; if not, it is completed when your next Command phase starts. Either way, it is only completed if the unit is still in range of that same marker. Once it is completed, your army has awakened that marker.

Score 4VP each time one of your units completes this action.

bff9f8a44dbc.name: Auspex Scan
bff9f8a44dbc.plain: Both players' units can do this action. Auspex Scan (Action): at the end of your Movement phase, 1 of your units in range of an objective marker your army hasn't scanned yet can start it, as long as no enemy unit other than AIRCRAFT is in range of that marker. It is completed at the end of your turn if the unit is still in range of the same marker. When it's completed, your army has scanned that objective marker.

c190cbb2af50.name: Relentless Assault
c190cbb2af50.plain: At the end of your turn, score 4VP if the number of your BLOOD ANGELS units in your opponent's deployment zone is higher than the number of enemy units in your deployment zone.

c2d364c07df7.name: Recon Sweep
c2d364c07df7.plain: Both players' units can do this action. Recon Sweep (Action): at the end of your Movement phase, 1 of your units in range of an objective marker your army hasn't reconnoitred yet can start it, as long as no enemy unit other than AIRCRAFT is in range of that marker. A unit with the Fast Attack Battlefield Role or with Objective Secured completes it at the end of your turn if it's still in range of the same marker. Any other unit completes it at whichever comes first, the start of your next Command phase or the end of the battle, if it's still in range of the same marker. When it's completed, your army has reconnoitred that objective marker.

c3186d24110b.name: Ambush
c3186d24110b.plain:
At the end of your turn, you can score each of these:
• 1 victory point if, this turn, 1 or more enemy units were destroyed while they had a crossfire marker.
• 1 victory point if, this turn, 1 or more enemy units were destroyed by your units that were set up from ambush or from underground in this same turn.
• 1 victory point if, this turn, a ranged attack by one of your models destroyed 1 or more enemy units that were Exposed when picked as that attack's target. The enemy unit has to have been Exposed, not by any other means (for example the Priority Target ability).

c407b5c1d9fb.name: Take Your Places
c407b5c1d9fb.plain:
If you pick this, in the Resolve Pre-battle Abilities step of the mission, you place 1 extra objective marker in your opponent's deployment zone. Your opponent then places 1 extra objective marker in your deployment zone, and 1 more within 6" of the battlefield's centre. These markers can't be placed within 9" of one another, within 6" of any battlefield edge, or within 3" of any other objective marker. They are your Take Your Places objective markers, and they only count as objective markers for this secondary objective, not for any other rule.
• At the end of your turn, you score 2VP if 2 of your Take Your Places markers are under your control and each of them has at least 1 of your HARLEQUINS units within range.
• At the end of your turn, you score 4VP instead if all 3 of your Take Your Places markers are under your control and each of them has at least 1 of your HARLEQUINS units within range.

c610e2e998c7.name: Destroy the Daemon
c610e2e998c7.plain:
At the end of the battle, score VP for each enemy unit that your GREY KNIGHTS units destroyed during the battle:
• A DAEMON PRIMARCH unit gives 5VP.
• Any other DAEMON MONSTER unit gives 3VP.
• A DAEMON VEHICLE unit gives 3VP.
• Any other DAEMON unit gives 1VP.

c8aa9b07aca5.name: Bolster Barricades
c8aa9b07aca5.plain:
If you pick this, your IMPERIAL FISTS units can do this action. Bolster Barricades (Action): at the end of your Movement phase, 1 or more of your IMPERIAL FISTS CORE INFANTRY units can start it. Each one must be in range of an objective marker that you control and that your army hasn't barricaded yet. It is completed when your next Command phase starts, or when the battle ends if that is sooner, as long as the unit is still in range of that same objective marker. Once it is completed, your army has barricaded that objective marker.

Each time one of your units completes this action:
• If the marker it barricaded was within your deployment zone, score 1VP.
• If the marker it barricaded was not within either player's deployment zone, score 4VP.
• For the rest of the battle, whenever an enemy unit attacks one of your IMPERIAL FISTS INFANTRY units that is wholly within 6" of an objective marker your army has barricaded, your unit gets the benefits of both Light Cover and Heavy Cover against it.

c9638b26c32a.name: Scry Futures
c9638b26c32a.plain:
If you pick this, your ASURYANI PSYKER units can attempt this psychic action.
Scry Futures (Psychic Action - Warp Charge 4): in your Psychic phase, 1 of your ASURYANI PSYKER units can attempt it if it is within range of an objective marker that you control and that your army hasn't scried yet. If it is completed, your army has now scried that objective marker.
You score 3VP each time one of your units completes this psychic action.

ca02f0813111.name: Search for the Portal
ca02f0813111.plain: Each time one of your units completes the Search for the Portal action, score 1 victory point plus 1 more for each objective marker labelled A you control at that moment, up to 5 victory points. Search for the Portal (Action): at the end of your Movement phase, 1 INFANTRY unit from your army (other than CHARACTERS) that is wholly within the Search Area can start it. It is completed at the end of your next Command phase if the unit is still wholly within the Search Area.

cb6866a005b0.name: Lightning Strike
cb6866a005b0.plain:
When your turn ends, score VP for enemy units destroyed by your WHITE SCARS units:
• 3VP for each enemy CHARACTER or MONSTER unit destroyed by a melee attack from a WHITE SCARS unit of yours that made a charge move this turn.
• 1VP for each other enemy unit destroyed by a melee attack from a WHITE SCARS unit of yours that made a charge move this turn.
• 1VP for each enemy unit destroyed by a ranged attack from a WHITE SCARS unit of yours that Advanced this turn.
This secondary objective gives you no more than 5VP per turn.

cc2a9b8a85da.name: Repair Teleport Homer
cc2a9b8a85da.plain: Score 5 victory points each time one of your units completes this action. Repair Teleport Homer (Action): at the end of your Movement phase, 1 INFANTRY unit from your army that is wholly within your opponent's deployment zone can start it. It is completed at the end of your next Command phase if the unit is still wholly within your opponent's deployment zone.

ce276ab173e3.name: Cranial Feasting
ce276ab173e3.plain:
Each time a melee attack by one of your HIVE TENDRIL models destroys an enemy CHARACTER model or unit champion, roll one D6. If that HIVE TENDRIL model has the FEEDER TENDRILS keyword, add 2 to the roll; if the destroyed model has the CHARACTER keyword, add 2 as well. On a 6+, you get 1 Command point (no more than 1 Command point can be gained this way in each battle round).
When the battle ends:
• Score 3 victory points if this objective gained you 1 or more Command points during the battle.
• Score 1 victory point per enemy CHARACTER model, and per enemy unit champion, that a melee attack from one of your HIVE TENDRIL models destroyed.
• Score 3 victory points if a melee attack from one of your HIVE TENDRIL models destroyed the enemy WARLORD.

cfb77b7d4c95.name: Recover Relics
cfb77b7d4c95.plain: At the start of a Command phase, a player gets the Battle-forged CP bonus only if they control at least 1 objective marker in no man's land or in their opponent's territory. Also, if a player controls the objective marker in their opponent's deployment zone at the start of their own Command phase, they gain 1 extra CP on top of the bonus.

d01250fdfe38.name: Warp Ritual
d01250fdfe38.plain: Keep a Ritual Points tally if you pick this, adding 1 each time one of your units completes this psychic action. Warp Ritual (Psychic Action - Warp Charge 4): in your Psychic phase, 1 PSYKER CHARACTER unit from your army within 6" of the centre of the battlefield can attempt it. At the end of the battle, score 3VP for a tally of 1, 7VP for 2, or 12VP for 3 or more.

d1bc7bf9d9e2.name: Raise the Banners High
d1bc7bf9d9e2.plain: If you pick this, your units can do this action. Raise Banners (Action): at the end of your Movement phase, 1 or more of your INFANTRY units can start it, each in range of a different objective marker that doesn't already have one of your banners on it. A unit can't start it while any enemy unit other than AIRCRAFT is in range of that objective marker. It is completed at the end of your turn. Then one of your banners is raised on that objective marker. The banner comes down if your opponent controls that marker at the start of any phase. For each objective marker on the battlefield with one of your banners on it, you gain 1 victory point whenever one of your Command phases ends, and 1 more victory point when the battle ends.

d1d0dd6c2b2b.name: Fleeing Vectors
d1d0dd6c2b2b.plain:
• When each player's turn ends, you score 2VP if your DEATH GUARD models' attacks destroyed 7 or more enemy models that turn. You score 1 extra VP if attacks with plague weapons destroyed 7 or more of those enemy models that turn.
• When each Morale phase ends, you score 2VP if 1 or more enemy units failed a Morale test in that phase. You score 1 extra VP if any of those failing units lost 1 or more models to attacks made with plague weapons this turn.

d2a52a86d8ab.name: Beasts for the Arenas
d2a52a86d8ab.plain: When the battle ends, gain 3 victory points for each enemy MONSTER, CAVALRY or BEAST unit destroyed by a melee attack from one of your <WYCH CULT> units. If that enemy unit was TITANIC, gain 5 victory points for it instead.

d36af006f50c.name: The Long War
d36af006f50c.plain:
At the end of your turn:
• Score 1 victory point per enemy unit destroyed this turn by your TRAITORIS ASTARTES units that was in range of an objective marker when this turn started.
• Score 2 victory points if you control any objective markers your opponent controlled when this turn started, and one of your TRAITORIS ASTARTES units is in range of any of those markers.
You can't score more than 3 victory points from this secondary objective in a turn.

d3feee9fff79.name: Detonation
d3feee9fff79.plain: In battle rounds 2, 3 and 4, at the end of each Command phase, the player whose turn it is gets 4VP for every one of these they meet, to a maximum of 12VP: controlling 1 or more objective markers; controlling 2 or more; controlling more objective markers than the opponent. In battle round 5, the player who took the first turn scores this at the end of their Command phase as normal, but the player who took the second turn scores it at the end of their turn instead. Then, when the battle ends, each player gets 4VP per Primed Explosives objective marker inside their opponent's territory, up to 15VP per player.

d4137b079298.name: Fury of the Lost
d4137b079298.plain: When your turn ends, gain 3 victory points if one of your DEATH COMPANY units destroyed 1 or more enemy units in that turn.

d55543344641.name: Corrupted Ground
d55543344641.plain: In battle rounds 2, 3 and 4, at the end of each Command phase, the player whose turn it is gets 4VP for every one of these they meet, to a maximum of 12VP: controlling 1 or more objective markers; controlling 2 or more; controlling more objective markers than the opponent. In battle round 5, the player who took the first turn scores this at the end of their Command phase as normal, but the player who took the second turn scores it at the end of their turn instead. Also, at the end of each of your turns (every battle round): gain 4VP if you control the objective marker in your opponent's deployment zone; gain 2VP if you control at least 1 objective marker in no man's land; lose 1VP if you don't control the one in your own deployment zone. Your score never drops below 0.

d88f9272f375.name: Code of Combat
d88f9272f375.plain: At the end of the battle, score 3 victory points for each enemy unit destroyed by one of your NECRONS NOBLE units.

d990fbba1744.name: Despoiled Ground
d990fbba1744.plain:
At the end of the battle, you score 3VP for each of these you achieve:
• At least 1 of your DEATH GUARD units is wholly within your opponent's deployment zone and at least 1 of your DEATH GUARD units is wholly within your deployment zone.
• You have DEATH GUARD units wholly within 3 different table quarters, and all those units are more than 3" away from any other table quarter.
• You have DEATH GUARD units wholly within 4 different table quarters, and all those units are more than 3" away from any other table quarter.
• You control at least half of all the objective markers on the battlefield, and each of those markers has your DEATH GUARD units within range.
• Each objective marker on the battlefield is in Contagion range of at least 1 Contagion ability that your DEATH GUARD units have.

db96ca7e2be9.name: Take and Hold
db96ca7e2be9.plain: Not scored in battle round 1. At the end of each Command phase, the player whose turn it is gets 5 victory points for every one of these they meet, to a maximum of 15: controlling 1 or more objective markers; controlling 2 or more; controlling more objective markers than the opponent.

dd236b2afd76.name: Purifying Ritual
dd236b2afd76.plain:
If you pick this, your GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER units can do this psychic action. Purifying Ritual (Psychic Action - Warp Charge 6): in your Psychic phase, 1 or more of your GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER units can attempt it. Each unit that starts it must be in range of a different objective marker that you control and that your army hasn't purified this turn. If the psychic action is completed, your army has purified that objective marker this turn.

At the end of your turn, score VP for how many objective markers your army purified this turn:
• 1 marker: 1VP.
• 2 markers: 2VP.
• 3 markers: 4VP.
• 4 or more markers: 5VP.

waive.PURIFYING RITUAL OBJECTIVES PURIFIED BY: a heading of the scoring table, not a keyword
waive.4+: the table's last row, "4+", means 4 or more; written out as "4 or more"

ddf1811d7c27.name: Ambush
ddf1811d7c27.plain:
At the end of your turn, score 2VP for each of these you achieve (up to 5VP per turn):
• This turn, your units destroyed 1 or more enemy units while they had a crossfire marker.
• This turn, your units that were set up from ambush or from underground this turn destroyed 1 or more enemy units.
• This turn, a ranged attack made by one of your models destroyed 1 or more enemy units, and that enemy unit was Exposed when it was picked as the target of that attack. It must have been Exposed in this way, not by any other means (such as the Priority Target Jackal Alphus ability).

dec902176a7a.name: Honour of the House
dec902176a7a.plain:
If you pick this, at the end of each battle round, gain 2 victory points if you have 6 Honour points, or if your Honour points total is higher than it was when that battle round started.
At the end of the battle:
• Gain 3 more victory points if your army is Virtuous.
• Gain 2 more victory points if your army is Honoured.
• If your army is Dishonoured, take 3 off the victory points earned from this secondary objective (it can't go below 0).

df01cf9e273f.name: Auric Mortalis
df01cf9e273f.plain:
If you pick this, in the Resolve Pre-battle Abilities step of the mission, choose 1 PRIMARCH or SUPREME COMMANDER unit in your opponent's army to be marked for death. If there isn't one, mark the unit in your opponent's army with the highest points value instead (ignore AIRCRAFT units). If 2 or more units tie, you pick which one. A unit's points value counts the points of all its weapons, wargear and upgrades.
At the end of the battle:
• Score 5VP if the marked unit is destroyed.
• Score 5VP if the marked unit was destroyed by a melee attack made by one of your ADEPTUS CUSTODES or ANATHEMA PSYKANA units.
• Score 5VP if both of the above are true and the marked unit wasn't within your deployment zone when it was destroyed.

df28c638abc0.name: Surround Them
df28c638abc0.plain: At the end of your Command phase, and again at the end of the battle, score 4 victory points if you control both objective markers in your deployment zone and at least 1 in your opponent's deployment zone. If you control all 4 objective markers that are in deployment zones, score 8 victory points instead.

e3e4645868b8.name: Exalt the Dark Gods
e3e4645868b8.plain:
If you pick this, keep an Exalt the Dark Gods tally. Add 1 to it each time one of your WORD BEARERS units completes this action. Exalt the Dark Gods (Action): at the end of your Movement phase, 1 of your WORD BEARERS INFANTRY units can start it if it is wholly within 6" of the battlefield's centre. WORD BEARERS PSYKER units can try to manifest psychic powers while doing this action, and the action doesn't fail because of it. If a WORD BEARERS DARK APOSTLE, WORD BEARERS ICON or WORD BEARERS MASTER OF POSSESSION unit is doing it, it is completed at the end of your turn; if not, it is completed when your next Command phase starts. Either way, it is only completed if the unit is still wholly within 6" of the battlefield's centre and no enemy units (not counting AIRCRAFT units) are wholly within 6" of the battlefield's centre.

At the end of the battle, score VP based on your tally:
• Tally of 1: 3VP.
• Tally of 2: 5VP.
• Tally of 3: 9VP.
• Tally of 4 or more: 15VP.

e51982a3eafb.name: Rise to Glory
e51982a3eafb.plain:
At the end of the battle round, you score 3VP for every CHARACTER, MONSTER or VEHICLE model destroyed during that battle round by an attack from one of your TRAITORIS ASTARTES CHARACTER models. For each such model with a Wounds characteristic of 10-19, you score 1 extra VP, or 2 extra VP if it had the TITANIC keyword or was the enemy WARLORD. This secondary objective gives you at most 5VP per battle round.
Each time a melee attack from one of your TRAITORIS ASTARTES CHARACTER models destroys a CHARACTER, MONSTER or VEHICLE model, roll 2D6. If the result is lower than that model's Wounds characteristic, you gain 1 Command point when the phase ends.

e633a305b135.name: The Blood God’s Due
e633a305b135.plain: Whenever a player's turn ends, score 1VP for every objective marker on the battlefield that was Drowned in Blood during that turn. A marker is Drowned in Blood if, during that turn, 1 or more units (not counting VEHICLE units) that were in range of it when the turn began were destroyed.

e81c8f6f808f.name: Slay the Heretic
e81c8f6f808f.plain:
At the end of each of your Shooting phases, gain 1 victory point per line below that is true:
• An attack with a bolt weapon by one of your ADEPTUS MINISTORUM units destroyed 1 or more enemy units.
• An attack with a flame weapon by one of your ADEPTUS MINISTORUM units destroyed 1 or more enemy units.
• An attack with a melta weapon by one of your ADEPTUS MINISTORUM units destroyed 1 or more enemy units.
If all 3 are true at the end of that Shooting phase, score 1 extra victory point (4 victory points at most).

e8765b05a20c.name: Adorn the Canvas Eclectic
e8765b05a20c.plain:
At the end of each turn, score 1VP for each of these you achieve:
• You control more objective markers than your opponent.
• Ranged attacks made by your EMPEROR'S CHILDREN units destroyed 1 or more enemy units this turn.
• Melee attacks made by your EMPEROR'S CHILDREN units destroyed 1 or more enemy units this turn.
• Attacks made by your EMPEROR'S CHILDREN CHARACTER units destroyed 1 or more enemy CHARACTER units this turn.

eb25038f5ea8.name: Accretion of Knowledge
eb25038f5ea8.plain:
When the battle ends, gain 3 victory points for each enemy model that has been destroyed and matches at least 1 of these:
• It has a Warlord Trait.
• It has a Relic.
• It is a VEHICLE with a Wounds characteristic of 14 or more.

eb5dc6af02e4.name: Bathe Your Blade in the Blood of Your Foe
eb5dc6af02e4.plain:
At the start of the first Command phase, you pick 1 of your BLACK TEMPLARS CHARACTER models to issue the challenge, and your opponent picks 1 of their CHARACTER models to accept it. A player who has no CHARACTER model picks their WARLORD instead.
When the battle ends, gain 5 victory points for each of these that has happened:
• The model that accepted the challenge was destroyed.
• It was destroyed by a melee attack.
• It was destroyed by a melee attack from the model that issued the challenge.

ebaeeca69bd6.name: Domination
ebaeeca69bd6.plain: Not scored in battle round 1. At the end of each Command phase, the player whose turn it is gets 5 victory points for every one of these they meet, to a maximum of 15: controlling 2 or more objective markers; controlling 3 or more; controlling more objective markers than the opponent.

eda893d43d03.name: Overrun
eda893d43d03.plain: In battle rounds 2, 3 and 4, at the end of each Command phase, the player whose turn it is gets 4VP for every one of these they meet, to a maximum of 12VP: controlling 2 or more objective markers; controlling 3 or more; controlling more objective markers than the opponent. In battle round 5, the player who took the first turn scores this at the end of their Command phase as normal, but the player who took the second turn scores it at the end of their turn instead. Also, in battle rounds 1, 2, 3 and 4, at the end of each of your turns you get 2VP if you control at least 1 objective marker in your opponent's territory. Then, when the battle ends, each player gets 3VP per objective marker they control in their opponent's territory.

edaad9b43835.name: Mutate Landscape
edaad9b43835.plain:
If you pick this, your THOUSAND SONS PSYKER units can do this psychic action. Mutate Landscape (Psychic Action - Warp Charge 5): in your Psychic phase, 1 PSYKER unit from your army can attempt it if it is in range of an objective marker that you control and that your army hasn't mutated yet. If the psychic action is completed, your army has mutated that marker.

Score 3VP each time one of your units completes this psychic action.

f07f6fa10989.name: Masters of Demolition
f07f6fa10989.plain:
If you pick this, then in the Resolve Pre-battle Abilities step of the mission your opponent sets up 3 objective markers anywhere on the battlefield. Each must be at ground level, not within 9" of the others, and not within 6" of any battlefield edge. None can go on a terrain feature with the Unstable Position terrain trait, and at most one of them can be within 6" of your opponent's deployment zone. If a marker can't be set up, it isn't set up. Each one is a demolition site. It only counts as an objective marker for this objective, not for any other rules.

Your IRON WARRIORS INFANTRY units can do this action. Total Demolition (Action): at the end of your Movement phase, 1 of your IRON WARRIORS INFANTRY units (not a CHARACTER unit) can start it if it is in range of a demolition site objective marker that you control. It is completed at the end of the turn if the unit is still in range of that same marker. Once it is completed, your army has demolished that marker: take it off the battlefield.

When the battle ends, score 4VP for every demolition site objective marker your army demolished. Score 4VP more if one of the demolition sites your army demolished had been within 6" of your opponent's deployment zone.

f1bafae5a705.name: Bring It Down
f1bafae5a705.plain: At the end of the battle, score VP for each enemy MONSTER or VEHICLE model that has been destroyed: 1VP if its Wounds characteristic is 9 or less, 2VP if it is 10-14, 3VP if it is 15-19, and 4VP if it is 20 or more.

f1fe53bcd824.name: Sacred Grounds
f1fe53bcd824.plain:
If you pick this, your units can attempt this action.
Sacred Grounds (Action): 1 or more of your ADEPTA SORORITAS INFANTRY or CULT IMPERIALIS PRIEST units can start this action at the end of your Movement phase. Each of those units needs to be within range of its own objective marker (a different one for each unit) that you control and that your army hasn't consecrated yet. The action is completed when your next Command phase starts or when the battle ends, whichever comes first. Once completed, your army has consecrated that objective marker, and for the rest of the battle it has the Inspiring (Adeptus Ministorum) terrain trait (it still doesn't count as a terrain feature for any other rule).
Each time one of your units completes this action, you score 1VP if the marker it consecrated is wholly within your deployment zone, or 4VP if not.

f21d755d1c09.name: Martial Interdiction
f21d755d1c09.plain:
If you pick this, after both sides have deployed but before the first turn starts, your opponent picks 1 CHARACTER model from their army. If they have no CHARACTER models, they pick their WARLORD instead. When the battle ends, gain:
• 6 victory points if a melee attack from one of your DARK ANGELS models destroyed the picked model.
• 3 more victory points if it was destroyed by a melee attack from one of your INNER CIRCLE or DEATHWING models.
• 6 more victory points if the unit of the DARK ANGELS model that destroyed it has not been destroyed itself.

f27e4b7787ef.name: Defend the Shrine
f27e4b7787ef.plain:
If you pick this, once both sides have deployed, your opponent picks 1 objective marker that isn't within their own deployment zone; it becomes the Sacred Shrine objective marker. If the battlefield's only objective marker is in the enemy's deployment zone, that one must be the Sacred Shrine.
• At the end of your turn, score 3 victory points if you control the Sacred Shrine.
• At the end of the battle, score 3 more victory points if you control the Sacred Shrine.
• At the end of the battle, if your opponent controls the Sacred Shrine, take 3 away from the victory points you've scored with this objective (it can't go below 0).

f3e7e52daa08.name: Retrieve Battlefield Data
f3e7e52daa08.plain: Keep a Retrieved Data tally if you pick this. Retrieve Data (Action): at the end of your Movement phase, 1 INFANTRY or BIKER unit from your army can start it if it is wholly within a table quarter where your army hasn't retrieved a servo-skull yet, and more than 6" from every other table quarter. It is completed at the end of your turn if the unit is still in the same table quarter. Then roll one D6, subtracting 1 if the unit is a Troops unit. If the result is no higher than the number of models the unit has left, your army has retrieved a servo-skull in that table quarter, and you add 1 to your tally. At the end of the battle, score 4VP for a tally of 2, 8VP for 3, or 12VP for 4.

f514ec96b462.name: Data Intercept
f514ec96b462.plain: Both players' units can do this action. Data Intercept (Action): at the end of your Movement phase, 1 of your units in range of the objective marker in its deployment zone can start it, as long as no enemy unit other than AIRCRAFT is in range of that marker. It is completed at the end of your turn if the unit is still in range of that marker.

f5367f99a475.name: Slay the Warlord
f5367f99a475.plain: At the end of the battle, score 6 victory points if the enemy WARLORD has been destroyed.

f553b360d28c.name: Encircle
f553b360d28c.plain: At the end of your turn, if you have at least 1 unit (other than AIRCRAFT) wholly within 6" of your battlefield edge and another unit (other than AIRCRAFT) wholly within 6" of the opposing player's battlefield edge, gain 3 victory points. Gain 5 victory points instead if one of those 2 units is wholly inside your opponent's deployment zone.

f59ea543c8f4.name: A Deadly Performance
f59ea543c8f4.plain:
At the end of your turn, gain 3 victory points if at least 2 of these are true:
• One of your HARLEQUINS units controls an objective marker you didn't control at the start of the turn.
• One of your HARLEQUINS units is wholly within your opponent's deployment zone.
• In this turn, attacks with ranged weapons by your HARLEQUINS models destroyed 2 or more enemy units.
• In this turn, attacks with melee weapons by your HARLEQUINS models destroyed 3 or more enemy units.

f67f58a9cf99.name: The Long Vigil
f67f58a9cf99.plain: Not scored in the first battle round. At the start of your Command phase, gain 5 victory points if no enemy units (not counting AIRCRAFT) are within 6" of your deployment zone and at least 1 of your DEATHWATCH units (not counting AIRCRAFT) is wholly within your deployment zone.

f6ed8d96974c.name: Precious Artefacts
f6ed8d96974c.plain: In battle rounds 2, 3 and 4, at the end of each Command phase, the player whose turn it is gets 4VP for every one of these they meet, to a maximum of 12VP: controlling 1 or more objective markers; controlling 2 or more; controlling more objective markers than the opponent. In battle round 5, the player who took the first turn scores this at the end of their Command phase as normal, but the player who took the second turn scores it at the end of their turn instead. Also, at the end of each of your turns (every battle round), you get 3VP if you control the Priority objective marker in your own territory.

f734c27d4be8.name: Break Them, Body and Soul
f734c27d4be8.plain: In battle rounds 2, 3 and 4, at the end of each Command phase, the player whose turn it is gets 4VP for every one of these they meet, to a maximum of 12VP: controlling 1 or more objective markers; controlling 2 or more; controlling more objective markers than the opponent. In battle round 5, the player who took the first turn scores this at the end of their Command phase as normal, but the player who took the second turn scores it at the end of their turn instead. Also, when each battle round ends, every player gets 1VP per enemy unit destroyed in that battle round, up to 3VP per player per battle round.

f91a61309160.name: Shock Tactics
f91a61309160.plain: At the end of your turn, score 4VP if you control 1 or more objective markers that your opponent controlled when that turn began, and one of your ADEPTUS ASTARTES units is in range of that marker.

f9b39d2c7713.name: Nourished by Terror
f9b39d2c7713.plain:
• Score 1VP each time an enemy model flees the battlefield.
• Each time one of your LEGIONES DAEMONICA units destroys an enemy unit, roll 2D6 before you remove the last model of that unit from the battlefield. If the result is equal to or higher than that enemy model's Leadership characteristic, score 1VP. A unit that is brought back for any reason (destroyed and then returned to the battlefield) can score you VP from this secondary objective more than once, if it is brought back and destroyed again several times and your 2D6 result equals or beats that model's Leadership characteristic each time.

f9defc7ad217.name: Decisive Action
f9defc7ad217.plain:
At the end of your turn, score 4VP if you control at least half of all the objective markers on the battlefield. Which battle rounds this works in depends on the Tactical Philosophy you picked at the start of the battle:
• Mont’ka: battle rounds 1, 2 and 3.
• Kauyon: battle rounds 3, 4 and 5.

fa4ab070e0e7.name: Codex Warfare
fa4ab070e0e7.plain:
At the end of the battle, look at each enemy unit that was destroyed by an attack from one of your ADEPTUS ASTARTES units, and score:
• 2VP if that attack used a Heavy or Grenade weapon while your army's Devastator Doctrine was active.
• 1VP if that attack used a Rapid Fire or Assault weapon while your army's Tactical Doctrine was active.
• 1VP if that attack used a Pistol or Melee weapon while your army's Assault Doctrine was active.
The most you can score from this secondary objective is 5VP while your army's Devastator Doctrine is active, 5VP while its Tactical Doctrine is active, and 5VP while its Assault Doctrine is active.

fa9b7e66d666.name: First Strike
fa9b7e66d666.plain: When the battle ends, gain 5 victory points if any enemy units were destroyed in battle round 1, and 3 more victory points if, in that round, more enemy units were destroyed than friendly units.

fae08d322e30.name: Sabotage Critical Location
fae08d322e30.plain:
After deployment zones are chosen, your opponent places 2 critical location markers on the battlefield. Each must be more than 9" from every battlefield edge and more than 9" from their other critical location marker. If both players have to place these markers, they take turns, with the Defender going first.
If you pick this, your units can do this action. Sabotage Critical Location (Action): 1 or more of your INFANTRY or BIKER units (CHARACTER units can't, except REDUCTUS SABOTEUR units) can start it when the Move Units step of your Movement phase ends. Every unit starting it must be within 3" of the centre of a different critical location marker belonging to your opponent. No enemy units (not counting AIRCRAFT units) may be within 3" of the centre of that marker. It is completed at the end of your turn, as long as the unit is still in range of that same critical location marker. Once it is completed, you have sabotaged that critical location: remove its marker from the battlefield.
Each time one of your units completes this action, gain victory points based on the battle round it was completed in:
• Battle round 2: 9 victory points.
• Battle round 3: 7 victory points.
• Battle round 4: 5 victory points.
• Battle round 5: 3 victory points.
This objective can't be scored in the first battle round.

waive.VICTORY POINTS SCORED: a heading of the scoring table, not a keyword

fae7f7a98a0a.name: Synaptic Insight
fae7f7a98a0a.plain:
If you pick this, keep a tally of Synaptic Kill points, resetting it to 0 when each battle round starts. Each time one of your SYNAPSE models destroys an enemy model, you gain Synaptic Kill points based on that enemy model's Wounds characteristic:
• Wounds 3-5: 1 point.
• Wounds 6-9: 2 points.
• Wounds 10 or more: 3 points.
When the battle round ends, score 3VP if your tally has reached 5 or more. This secondary objective can give you no more than 12VP in the battle.

fc4ff3fc2a86.name: Attrition
fc4ff3fc2a86.plain: At the end of each battle round, score 4 victory points if more enemy units than friendly units were destroyed during that battle round.

fd4ccb716bd4.name: Carry Out Your Vows
fd4ccb716bd4.plain:
You can only pick this if you have picked any Templar Vows. It has a Progressive part and an End Game part. For the End Game part, you can only score for the Templar Vow you picked at the end of the Read Mission Briefing step, not for any other vow you picked during the battle.
Progressive part: at the end of the battle round, you score 4VP if melee attacks made by your BLACK TEMPLARS units destroyed more enemy units this battle round than the number of your BLACK TEMPLARS units that were destroyed this battle round. You can score at most 12VP per battle from this part.
End Game part: at the end of the battle, you score 5VP if any of these is true:
• Your vow before the battle was Suffer Not the Unclean to Live, and a melee attack made by one of your BLACK TEMPLARS CHARACTER units destroyed the enemy WARLORD during the battle.
• Your vow before the battle was Uphold the Honour of the Emperor, and at the end of the battle one of your BLACK TEMPLARS INFANTRY units (not CHARACTER units) that isn't below Half-strength is in your opponent's deployment zone.
• Your vow before the battle was Abhor the Witch, Destroy the Witch, and your BLACK TEMPLARS units destroyed 1 or more enemy PSYKER CHARACTER units during the battle.
• Your vow before the battle was Accept Any Challenge, No Matter the Odds, and during the battle one of your BLACK TEMPLARS units destroyed either an enemy model with a Wounds characteristic of 20 or more, or an enemy unit whose Starting Strength was 20 or more models.

fd6e9dec09e4.name: Cold Fury
fd6e9dec09e4.plain:
At the end of your turn, score 1VP for each of these you achieve (maximum 4VP):
• At least 1 of your IRON HANDS VEHICLE units (not AIRCRAFT units) is within your opponent's deployment zone.
• At least 1 of your IRON HANDS VEHICLE units (not AIRCRAFT units) is within 6" of the battlefield's centre.
• Ranged attacks by your IRON HANDS VEHICLE units destroyed at least 1 enemy unit this turn.
• Melee attacks by your IRON HANDS VEHICLE units destroyed at least 1 enemy unit this turn.

fea89db94ed3.name: Codex Warfare
fea89db94ed3.plain:
If you pick this, you score victory points at the end of the battle like this:
• 1 victory point (up to 5) for each enemy unit destroyed by an attack from your ADEPTUS ASTARTES units with a Heavy or Grenade weapon while your army's Devastator Doctrine was active.
• 1 victory point (up to 5) for each enemy unit destroyed by an attack from your ADEPTUS ASTARTES units with a Rapid Fire or Assault weapon while your army's Tactical Doctrine was active.
• 1 victory point (up to 5) for each enemy unit destroyed by an attack from your ADEPTUS ASTARTES units with a Pistol or Melee weapon while your army's Assault Doctrine was active.

feee9ddcfa52.name: Reality Rebels
feee9ddcfa52.plain:
At the end of your turn:
• You score 1VP for each table quarter that has at least 1 of your LEGIONES DAEMONICA units wholly within it, as long as your opponent doesn't have more units wholly within that same quarter. For this bullet, ignore units within 6" of the battlefield's centre.
• You score 1VP if at least 1 of your LEGIONES DAEMONICA units is wholly within 6" of the battlefield's centre.

ff6b5ecd03bb.name: The Treasures of Aeons
ff6b5ecd03bb.plain:
If you pick this, then in the Resolve Pre-battle Abilities step of the mission your opponent picks 3 objective markers on the battlefield. They can't pick markers in their own deployment zone until they have already picked every objective marker in no man's land.

At the end of your turn, if you control 1 or more of those picked markers, score VP for how many you control:
• 1 picked marker: 2VP.
• 2 picked markers: 3VP.
• 3 picked markers: 4VP.

waive.THE TREASURES OF AEONS NUMBER OF SELECTE: a heading of the scoring table, not a keyword
waive.VICTORY POINTS: a heading of the scoring table, not a keyword

ffa4c5414d90.name: Sabotage Critical Location
ffa4c5414d90.plain:
If you pick this, then in the Resolve Pre-battle Abilities step of the mission your opponent places 2 critical location markers on the battlefield. Each one has to be more than 9" from every battlefield edge and more than 9" from their other critical location marker. If both players have to place these markers, they take turns, and the Defender goes first.

Your GENESTEALER CULTS and BROOD BROTHERS units can then do this action. Sabotage Critical Location (Action): when the Move Units step of your Movement phase ends, 1 or more of your GENESTEALER CULTS INFANTRY, BROOD BROTHERS INFANTRY or GENESTEALER CULTS BIKER units can start it. CHARACTER units can't, unless they are REDUCTUS SABOTEUR units. Each unit that starts it must be in range of a different one of your opponent's critical location markers, and you must control that marker. It is completed at the end of your turn if the unit is still in range of that same marker. Once it is completed, you have sabotaged that critical location: take the marker off the battlefield.

Each time one of your units completes this action, score VP depending on the battle round in which it was completed:
• Battle round 2: 10VP.
• Battle round 3: 8VP.
• Battle round 4: 7VP.
• Battle round 5: 6VP.
